chapters: Na pai' dhuuk cham tu'x jai'ch ka't, gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu tɨkɨr gio gu oidha'.
Gio gu oidha' cham tu'x bhaan ka't gio jix tukgam, gio gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix mii'ñdhix bhaan gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios: «Na jix tasi' ka'», gio ba' jix tasi' jum duu.
Gio gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi' gu tasi' na jix bhai' ka't; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix ai'chdhix gu tasi' gio gu tukgam.
Gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jup tɨɨt Tanoolh gu tasi', gio gu tukgam jup tɨɨt Tukaa'; gio ba' xumai jum duu gio xibh jum duu, maa'n tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ka't gu tɨkɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' jix ai'chdhix gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu takarui' gu tɨkɨr jix ai'chdhix gu suudai' mi'p bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr gu suudai' mi'p bhaan gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' ka't.
Gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jup tɨɨt Tɨkɨr gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' xumai jum duu gio xibh jum duu, gook tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jum daa'ñ gu suudai' bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr pai' jix ñi'ñ jix gaki; mi' dhɨr ka't.
Gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jup tɨɨt Oidha' gu jix gaki oidha', gio gu suudai' na jum daa'ñ jup tɨɨt Gɨ' Suudai'; gio gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi' na jix bhai' ka't.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu vaas jix maa gu kai'; mi' dhɨr gu u'u gu i'bhɨ jix maa gu i'bhɨ bhaan na jax chu'm gu kai' bhaan gu oidha'; jano' ba' ka't.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu vaas jix maa gu kai' bhaan na jax chu'm gu u'u jix maa gu i'bhɨ gu kai' bhaan na jax chu'm; gio ba' jix ñi' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu xumai gu xibh gu tanoolh vaik.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios: «Na jai'ch ka' gu tasi' tɨkɨr bhaan gu tɨkɨr na ba' jix ai'chdhix gu tanoolh gio gu tukaa', na ba' ka't pai' dhuuk gio gu tanoolh».
Gio na ka't gu tasi' tɨkɨr bhaan gu tɨkɨr na ba' jix tas duu bhaan gu oidha'; gio ba' ja'p jum duu.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gook jix gɨ' tasi' tɨkɨr, gu jix gɨ' tas na jix gɨ'kora' bhaan gu tanoolh, gio gu masad na jix ali' na jix gɨ'kora' bhaan gu tukaa', gio gu si'avag.
Gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas bhaan gu tɨkɨr na ba' jix tas duu bhaan gu oidha'.
Gio na jix gɨ'kora' bhaan gu tanoolh gio bhaan gu tukaa', gio na jix ai'chdhix gu tasi' gio gu tukgam; gio gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi' na jix bhai' ka't.
Gio ba' xumai jum duu gio xibh jum duu, maakobh tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix buusñi gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ na jix do'ig gu u'uvhig da'a bhaan gu oidha' jix kupi'ook gu tɨkɨr.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai gu chuukug ko'oi na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim gu suudai' gu ñi'ook bhaan na jax chu'm bɨx gu u'uvhig gu suudai' bhaan na jax chu'm; gio ba' jix ñi' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu takarui' jix bhai' aa' bham; gio ba' jix maa gu i'bhɨ gu ñi'ook jix bhuup gu suudai' gu gɨ' suudai' gu u'uvhig gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu xumai gu xibh gu tanoolh jixchamaam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu i'ii'ñ na jix do'ig bhaan na jax chu'm gu vaakax gu ko'oi gu vaakax gu oidha' bhaan na jax chu'm; mi' dhɨr ka't.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu vaakax gu oidha' bhaan na jax chu'm gu vaakax bhaan na jax chu'm bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu ko' na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu oidha' bhaan na jax chu'm; gio ba' jix ñi' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhai'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duu gu chio'ñ gu kutun na jax chu'm jurtu'nka' gu kutun na jax chu'm; mi' dhɨr jix gɨ'kora' gu vatop gu gɨ' suudai' gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr gu vaakax bɨx gu oidha' bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu chuukug ko'oi na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ na jax chu'm gu takarui'; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ jix duu.

Ba' jix aa' jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix maa gu i'bhɨ gu ñi'ook jix bhuup gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' bhaan gu vatop gu gɨ' suudai' gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr bɨx gu vaakax oidha' bhaan jiim bhaan pai'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu suudai' jix maa bɨx gu vaas jix maa gu kai' bhaan gu vupui bɨx gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu u'u cham tu'x jai'ch gu i'bhɨ gu u'u jix maa gu kai' ka't na ba' jugi.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu vaakax gu oidha' bɨx gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr bɨx oidha' bhaan jiim bhaan pai' cham tu'x jai'ch pai' bɨx gu vaas ka't na ba' jugi; gio ba' ka't.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx ka't gu ñi'ook gu suudai' ka't jix bhai'; gio ba' ka't gu xumai gu xibh gu tanoolh xijumai.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' bɨx gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix bɨɨx duu gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh kɨɨv gu ñi'ook jix utu'ñ gu tanoolh kɨɨv bɨx gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh kɨɨv jix bhaan duu na gu' jix utu'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu dhi' ja'tkam gu suudai' gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' na pai' dhuuk jix bɨɨx duu gu bhóogɨt gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu vaas yooxi' va'k jum duu gu oidha' bɨx gu vaas yooxi' va'k gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu suudai' cham ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bhaan gu oidha' tu' ka't gu chio'ñ na ba' tu juan pai'.
Gu' gu' jix tɨ'ɨ gu oidha' toov jix suudai' duu bɨx gu vupui gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ oo' gu oidha' jix duñia' daak gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; gio ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu i'ii'ñ na jix do'ig.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu ux na tu ibai' u'uu pai' gu Edeen tas buusñi jix dhaas gu chio'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook maaxilhia' gu oidha' bɨx gu u'u jix bhai'x ñiata jix bhai' na ba' jugi; gio ba' gio gu u'u gu oidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ u'uu pai' gu u'u gu duukam xoi'kam cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' busaak gu Edeen gɨ' suudai' jiim na ba' jix suudai' duu u'uu pai' gu bhóogɨt maakobh gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' maa'n ka't gu Pisoon; gio ba' gu ux mia'n bɨx gu oidha' gu abila pai' cham tu'x jai'ch jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' jix uam jodai mii' dhɨr gu oidha' jix bhai'; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch gio gu bhóogɨt gu jodai gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gook gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Gioon; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook bɨx gu oidha' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' vaik gɨ' suudai' jiim gu iddekel; gio ba' gu ux tu' vupui bhaan gu Asiria; mi' dhɨr maakobh gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Euprates.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ jix dhaas u'uu pai' gu Edeen na ba' tu juan jix nukadham.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ bham; gio ba' bɨx gu u'u u'uu pai' jugi.
Gu' gu' gu u'u gu duukam xoi'kam cham bhai' cham jugi; na gu' gu tanoolh jugi koi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham jix bhai' gu chio'ñ gu duukam; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' na ba'.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' bɨx gu vaakax yooxi' bɨx gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook na ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook ka't tɨɨt; gio ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook jup tɨɨt gu vaakax na jix do'ig gu takarui' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Adam gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨx gu vaakax gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n yooxi'; gu' na ba' gu Adam cham gu ñi'ook gu takarui' na jix bhai' na ba'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug koox bhaan gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix koox; gio ba' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ o'oo gu ñi'ook gu chuukug pai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu o'o gu Jawatan Dios jix bhɨɨ gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ jix bhɨɨ gu chio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' dhi' jano' o'o o'oo gu chuukug; na gu' gu chuukug ka't mɨmɨim gu u'vɨ na gu' gu chio'ñ ka't jix bhɨɨ.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' kiicha' gu chio'ñ gu taat gu naan maa'n gu u'vɨ ka't gu duukam gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' mi'p gu ñi'ook dha'npak gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ cham gu ñi'ook.

Gu' gu' gu ko'oi ka't jix maat gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu vaakax yooxi' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix aa' gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' cham jugi bɨx gu u'u u'uu pai'.
Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ jix aa' gu ko'oi; gio ba' gu i'bhɨ gu u'u u'uu pai' jugi.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu i'bhɨ gu u'u tɨjɨɨ'ñ u'uu pai' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' cham jugi tu' gu ñi'ook na gu' cham gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu ko'oi gu u'vɨ; gio ba' cham koi.
Gu' gu' gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh jugi ka't gu bhóogɨt gu vupui ka't na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios pu'ñir xoi'kam cham bhai'.

Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu u'vɨ gu u'u ka't jix bhai' na ba' jugi ka't jix bhai'x gu vupui gu u'u jix bhai'x na ba' gu oi'ñga'n matda'; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu i'bhɨ jix jugi; mi' dhɨr jix maa gio gu chio'ñ jix jugi na ja'p.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu bhóogɨt gu vupui ba'k jix maati' mi'p dha'npak; gio ba' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jajar iigɨx jix duu gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' u'uu pai' gu bhóogɨt gu tanoolh; gio ba' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'u u'uu pai'.
Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ; gio ba' duukat gu jodai' tu'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook u'uu pai' jix duñia' ɨɨbhi'ñ na gu' ka't tɨbiaptuda; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' chɨkka tu' jix duñia' dhi' tɨbiaptuda jugi gu u'u tu' jix aa'ñdhix cham jugi.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ jix aa'; gio ba' gu u'vɨ chɨɨdak gu ux gu ñi'ook jix maa gu u'u tu' jugi.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix aa' gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr gu ko'oi jix duñia' jugi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu ko'oi; na gu' dhi' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug ka' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu vaakax tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu vaakax yooxi'; mi' dhɨr bhaan baaso gu jodai' oo' jugi bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu u'vɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kai' gu jodai'; gio ba' gu chuukug tu' gu ñi'ook mo'o tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu jodai' gu vaak gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx gu vaak gu jodai' gu ma'nkam; jano' ba' gu chio'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu'.

Ba' jix aa' gu chio'ñ; na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ jugi gu u'u tu' jix aa'ñdhix bham cham jugi; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug ka't gu oidha' gu ux xoi'kam tu'; jano' ba' bɨɨx gu vaak jugi bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' tu' gu takarui' jugi gu vaas yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu vupui jugi gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' gu oidha'; na gu' gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ; na gu' oo' gu chuukug oo' ka' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu chio'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ' gu u'vɨ gu Eeba; na gu' ka't gu naan bɨx na jix do'ig.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook tɨɨt jix duñia'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu suudai' gu chio'ñ na ja'p maa'n pu'ñir xoi'kam cham bhai'; na gu' jano' na gu' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu novɨ jix bhɨɨ gio gu u'u gu oidha' jugi gu tai na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu Jawatan Dios u'uu pai' gu Edeen na ba' tu juan gu oidha' ka't jix bhɨɨ.
Jano' ba' mi'x juu'ñ mai' gu chio'ñ jix dhaas tas buusñi u'uu pai' gu Edeen gu suudai' gu kuchii gu tai gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu oi'ñga'n na ba' nukadham gu bhóogɨt gu u'u gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu Adam gu u'vɨ gu Eeba jix duñia' gu Kaiin; gio ba' gu jodai' gu chio'ñ gu ux gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix duñia' xibhɨk gu Abel; gio ba' ka't gu Abel bipia'dam kakneer gu Kaiin ka't tu juan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Kaiin jix bhɨɨ gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Abel jix bhɨɨ gio maa'nkam mar kakneer gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Abel gu maa'nkar.
Gu' gu' cham gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Kaiin gu maa'nkar gu jodai'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Kaiin jix duñia' gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Kaiin; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu ñi'ook tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu vupui.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook cham ka' gu oi'ñga'n tu' cham gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ ki'ñgob; gio ba' bɨɨx bɨx dhi' tu' ka't gu ñi'ook tu' gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Kaiin xibhɨk gu Abel; gio ba' ka't kua' yooxi' gu Kaiin jix búup bhaan xibhɨk gu Abel mu'aa.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Kaiin; gio ba' duukat gu Abel xibhɨk jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham tu'; jano' ba' jix duñia' tu' jix nukadham xibhɨk.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr xibhɨk duuñ tu' dɨr gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu kutun gu ñi'ook tu' gu oidha' jix kupi'ook gu chin na ba' gu takarui' gu ɨ'ɨr xibhɨk gu novɨ.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tu juan gu oidha' cham tu' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu kavɨk; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ ja'tkam mii' dhɨr ka' gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Kaiin gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' mi'x juu'ñ gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu oidha' gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug no'x gu ñi'ook mu'aa.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tɨɨda' no'x gu bhóogɨt gu Kaiin kɨɨv mui'kim ka't gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas nɨi'ñchudat gu Kaiin na ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n no'x bakia'.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu Kaiin vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix daa gu oidha' gu Nod tas buusñi gu Edeen.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Kaiin gu u'vɨ jix duñia' gu enok; gio ba' pai'x kiicham jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' kiicham gu tɨɨgɨ' gu mar gu enok.
Jano' ba' gu enok jix duñia' gu Irad jix mar gu Meujael jix mar gu Metusael jix mar gu Lamek.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ na ba' gu Lamek gook gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't gu Ada gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Silla.
Jano' ba' gu Ada jix duñia' gu Jabal ka't gu taat gu bhóogɨt vaak zel gu takarui' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' xibhɨk ka't gu Jubal ka't gu taat bɨx gu jodai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Silla gio jix duñia' gu Tubal-kaiin gu suudai' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam jix kavɨk jodai; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu Tubal-kaiin ka't gu Naama.
Ba' jix aa' gu Lamek gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu Ada gu Silla gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu u'vɨ gu Lamek gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu ñi'ook; na gu chio'ñ kooda' gu ux gu ñi'ook biapma' gu ux koi'm.
Jano' ba' tu' kɨɨv mui'kim ka't gu chuukug gu Kaiin gu Lamek tu'r gu vaak mui'kim kɨɨv ka't.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix vɨɨk gu Adam gu u'vɨ jix duñia' gu mar jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Set; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' tu' gu chuukug gu kai' pai' gu Abel mu'aa gu Kaiin.
Jano' ba' gu Set gio jix duñia' gu mar jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Enoos; gio ba' jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ kua'da' mɨmɨim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' dhi' u'uan gu ma'nkam gu Adam; gio ba' gu tanoolh jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ na jax chu'm gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ; gio ba' jix bhai' aa' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh jix bɨɨx duu gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix oidha' gu Adam chamaam gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix mar gu mar na jax chu'm jurtu'nka' na jax chu'm jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Set.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu tanoolh gu Adam mi' dhɨr jix mar gu Set gu chuukug gu takarui'; gio ba' jix mar gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu bɨx gu tanoolh jix oidha' gu Adam gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix koi.
Jano' ba' jix oidha' gu Set chamaam jixchamaam gu takarui' jix mar gu Enoos.

Jano' ba' gu Joktaan jix mar gu Almodad gu Selep gu asarmabet gu Jera.

Jano' ba' ka't ba'bhak dɨr gu Mesa bai'ñpu' gu Separ gu kavɨk baasɨ'n tas buusñi.

Jano' ba' ka't jano' ba' bɨx gu oidha' nɨɨn gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu chuukug gu takarui' kiicham bhi'ñbak gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tɨkɨr; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ux tu' tu'ch gu suudai' bhaan gu vupui bɨx gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Siddim ka't jix bhuup gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jiboi'ññor gu gɨ'kora' gu Sodoma gu Gomorra ia'rɨ; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' jiboi'ññor gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu Sodoma gu Gomorra bɨx gu takarui' jix bɨɨx duu.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio gu Lot gu mar xibhɨk gu Abraam jix koi gu Sodoma gu i'ii'ñ jix bɨɨx duu.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va maa'n jix duñia' gu Abraam gu ebreo jix duñia' gu suudai' gu Mamre gu Amorreo xibhɨk gu Eskôl xibhɨk gu Aner mi'p gu suudai' bɨɨx gu Abraam.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu Abraam xibhɨk ka't gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu vaak vaik gu bhóogɨt chɨ'ɨɨk bɨɨx ka'm gu Dan.
Jano' ba' ja'aa bhaan gu tukaa' tu duukam naaka'n ka't gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu oba o'nsop gu Damasko.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx xoi'kam gio gu Lot xibhɨk gu i'ii'ñ gio gu u'vɨ gu ja'tkam.
Na pai' dhuuk jix buus gu gɨ'kora' gu Sodoma tu jiim na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu duukam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx mi'p gu ñi'ook gu Sabe gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Melkîsedek gu gɨ'kora' gu Salem jix buusñi gu takarui' suudai' u'va; gio ba' ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai'x.
Ba' jix aa' jix bhai' aa'; gio ba' gu takarui' ka't gu Abraam gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai'x bia'ka' gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' ka't gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai'x do'ñcho gu ñi'ook gu novɨ; gio ba' jix maa gu Abraam boosgi bɨx.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Sodoma gu Abraam; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt jix bhɨɨ na ba' tu' gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Abraam gu gɨ'kora' gu Sodoma; gio ba' gu suudai' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai'x bia'ka' gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'.
Na gu' dɨr gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt cham tu' jix bhɨɨ bɨx gu oi'ñga'n na gu' cham gu chuukug; gio ba' tu' gu chuukug gu Abraam.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' koi'mɨk biipibop gu maa'nkar gu chichio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu Eskôl gu Mamre; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ baasɨ'n.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'x ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' cham jum i'obh gu Abraam; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt daam jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Abraam; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu suudai' gu ñi'ook cham gu mar gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu vaak gu takarui' gu Damaskeno gu Elieser.
Ba' jix aa' gu oi'ñga'n gu Abraam; gio ba' gu suudai' cham jix maa gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' bi'ya' maa'n maaxir gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't bham; gio ba' cham tu' jix duñia' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu jodai' ba'k ka't tu' gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' jix buusñi mai'; gio ba' gu suudai' jano' gu tɨkɨr jix duñia' gu si'avag tu' no'p gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' ka't gu kai'.
Gu Abraam jix bhaan jum ai'ch gu Jawatan Dios, gio mi' dhɨr jix bhaan jum tɨɨ na jir bɨx bhai'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Ur gu Kaldeos na ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu takarui' no'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook vaik gu takarui' gu ñi'ook vaik gu takarui' gu ñi'ook vaik gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gio gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ bɨx dhi' tu'x ta'tak gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gu' cham ta'tak gu u'uvhig.
Jano' ba' jix dhaav gu u'uvhig bhaan gu chuukug koko'kam jix duñia' gu Abraam.
Gu' gu' gu chuukug gu tas daam koox gu Abraam gu suudai' gu takarui' jix gɨ' gu duukam jix duñia' bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abraam; gio ba' mambhɨɨx gu ux tɨɨda' gu kai' ka't gu takarui' gu oidha' cham gu jodai' tu juan ka't gu ux gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui'.
Gu' gu' gio gu ja'tkam tu juan gu bhóogɨt tu'; gio ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' tu' ɨlhdham tattat bhai'x i'ii'ñ ka' jix duñia' jix bhai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x; na gu' gu suudai' cham jix duñia' tu' na cham jir bhai' gu Amorreo bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tas tu' gu jodai' mi'x dhaas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt kañdhiir gu tai gu ñi'ook gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaakax gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' jix duu mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu Abraam bham; gio ba' gu kai' gu suudai' dhi' gu oidha' dɨr gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm gɨ' suudai' jiim jix gɨ' gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Euprates.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Kenekeos gu Kedmoneos.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu Amorreos gu Kananeos gu ñi'ook gu Jebuseos.
Jano' ba' gu Saara gu u'vɨ gu Abraam cham gu chuukug; gio ba' ga'ra' ja'tkam na tu juan gu jodai' jup tɨɨt gu Agar.

Ba' jix aa' gu Saara gu Abraam; gio ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook koi'm; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n ja'tkam na tu juan; jano' ba' gu kutun gu oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Abraam tu ñi'ook gu Saara.

Jano' ba' gu Saara gu u'vɨ gu Abraam jix bhɨɨ gu Agar ja'tkam na tu juan gu jodai' gu maa'nkar mambhɨɨx gu takarui' ka't gu chuukug gu Abraam gu oidha' gu Kanaan jix maa gu Abraam gu chio'ñ gu ux gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu Agar jix duñia'; na pai' dhuuk jix ñi' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' bɨɨx gu vaak aapi'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Saara gu Abraam; gio ba' gu ja'tkam ka't bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu takarui' ja'tkam na tu juan baaso gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu suudai' bɨɨx gu vaak; jano' ba' gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Abraam gu Saara; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n ja'tkam na tu juan gu novɨ gu vupui bɨɨx xoi'kam tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu Saara gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ju'ñdharan suudai' buusñi gu suudai' oidha' jix gaki ju'ñdharan suudai' buusñi gu bhóogɨt gu Sur.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Agar ja'tkam na tu juan gu Saara duukat gu jodai' tu' duukat gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu Saara aapi'.
Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt aapi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ.
Ba' jix aa' gio nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu jodai' gu ma'nkam cham ka't jix duñia' kuiñcha gu oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' gu bhóogɨt nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu mar mɨmɨim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Ismael na gu' naak tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu takarui'; gio ba' gu novɨ bhaan bɨx gu noobh bɨx bhaan vupui bhaan bɨx gu ja'tkam jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ua'rgidhimɨk; gio ba' tu' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios ñiata; na gu' jix aa'; jano' ba' cham buupui gio tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ux jup tɨɨt gu ñi'ook na jix do'ig tu'; gio ba' gu suudai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Kades gu Bered.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Agar gu Abraam gu mar jup tɨɨt gu Abraam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu mar jix duñia' gu Agar gu Ismael.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Abraam gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x gu ux gu takarui' na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu Agar gu Ismael.

Ba' jix aa' gu suudai' gu Abraam gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix ñi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Gɨ'kora' Jawatan; mi' dhɨr jiim vupui bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt ñi'ook na jix bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu jodai' jix jai'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abraam jix duñia' bhaan gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bham.
Jano' ba' gu Yo gu suudai' ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨndak; gio ba' ka' gu taat gu oi'ñga'n chɨbɨɨp.
Na gu' cham tɨɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Abraam gu ñi'ook ka't gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Abraam na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu taat gu oi'ñga'n chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' tu' gu jodai' jix jai' tu' gu bhóogɨt chɨbɨɨp gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ñi'ook na jix bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu kai' mi' dhɨr tu' gu ma'nkam gu ux ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu suudai' tu' gu ux gu Jawatan Dios gu kai' mi' dhɨr tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu suudai' tu' gu kai' mi' dhɨr tu' gu oidha' gu chuukug bɨx gu oidha' gu Kanaan gu maa'nkar gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' jix vɨɨk gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam; gio ba' tu' cham gu ñi'ook nukadham ñi'ook na jix bhaan tu' gu kai' mi' dhɨr tu' gu ux gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't ñi'ook na jix bhaan nukadham tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu kai' mi' dhɨr tu'; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook bɨx gu chio'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook ka't gu ux nɨi'ñchudat ñi'ook na jix bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tasi' gu tanoolh ka't gu ñi'ook bɨx gu chio'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ma'nkam; gio ba' maaxir gu vaak jugi tuumiñ gu chuukug ja'tkam mii' dhɨr cham ka't gu kai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ñi'ook maaxir gu vaak jugi gu ux tuumiñ; gio ba' jix duñia' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu chuukug na ba' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook cham ka't gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't gu suudai' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' gio gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam; gio ba' gu Saara gu u'vɨ cham mɨmɨim gu Saara gu' gu Saara ka't gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' jix bhai' aa' gio tu' gu suudai' gu mar; gio ba' jix bhai' aa' ɨlhdham gu suudai' gu naan gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam ka't.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abraam jix duñia' bhaan gu vupui jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu takarui' tu' maaxilhia' gu mar gu Saara tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' tu' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abraam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Ismael gu tai vupui bhaan tu'.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Saara gu u'vɨ tu' gu ñi'ook gu mar mɨmɨim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Isaak; mi' dhɨr gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu ux ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu kai' mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu Ismael gio tu' naak; gio ba' gu suudai' jix bhai' aa' gu bhóogɨt jix mui' jum duu jix mui' jix jai'; mi' dhɨr gu kutun chiñia' jix mar gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu ja'tkam.
Gu' gu' tu' dhi' ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu Isaak tu' gu ñi'ook gu Saara gu ux dhi' gu ñi'ook oi'ñga' buimgidhak.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu ñiokda' bɨɨx jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu Abraam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Abraam gu Ismael gu mar bɨx tu duukam gu ñi'ook gu vaak bɨx jiimɨt gu ux tuumiñ bɨx gu chio'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu Abraam jix duñia' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Abraam gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu takarui' na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk gu Ismael gu mar ka't gu suudai' gu takarui' na pai' dhuuk ka't gu jodai' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh ka't gu ñi'ook gu Abraam gu Ismael gu mar.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu vaak tu duukam maaxir gu vaak jugi gu ux tuumiñ ja'tkam mii' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix ñi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' gu Mamre kua' daakat ki'ñgob vaak zel jix tónom gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu vupui jix duñia' gu suudai' vaik gu chichio'ñ mi'p ju'ñdharan; na pai' dhuuk jix ñi' jix buus jix duñia' ki'ñgob vaak zel tu jiim jix duñia' bhaan gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan tu' jano' gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui jix duñia' cham gu ñi'ook tu duukam.
Na gu ñi'ook jano' gu vaak gu suudai' jix duñia' tɨɨt; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n bɨtaa'n gu u'u.

Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu chin gu takarui' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mia'n tu duukam; jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu vupui na ja'p tu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abraam ka't gu chuukug vaak zel gu Saara; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ jootom vaik gu suudai' gu chuukug gu tasi' jix duñia' gu vupui gu takarui' gu chuukug bɨtaa'n gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' dai'bus gu Abraam gu jodai' jix bhɨɨ tuur jix bhai'x jix bhai' jix maa gu takarui' jix maa gu ux gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio gu oi'ñga'n bii'm tuur ka't gu bhóogɨt jix dhaas vupui bhaan; gio ba' ka't ju'ñdharan bɨtaa'n gu u'u; mi' dhɨr koi'mɨk.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' duukat gu Saara gu u'vɨ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr vaak zel.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' tɨɨda' gu jodai' tu' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu mar gu Saara gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr gu Saara jix duñia' ki'ñgob vaak zel ka't gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu Abraam gu Saara jix duñia' kɨklhi'ñga'n ba'k gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu Saara ka't jix duñia' tu' gu takarui' gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Saara tɨjɨɨ'ñ bham; gio ba' mi' dhɨr gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gio gu Jawatan tu' jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook tu' gu jodai' gu Saara bham; mi' dhɨr ka't tɨɨda' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' tu' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' cham tu'x jai'ch na ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu ñi'ook nɨi'ñchudat gu jodai' tu' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Saara gu oi'ñga'n gu mar.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Saara jix duñia' bham; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook; na gu' jix duñia' ɨɨbhi'ñ; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ jix búup tu jiim bhaan gu Sodoma; gio ba' gu Abraam gu chuukug bɨɨx gu jodai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu Abraam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ duñia'.
Jano' ba' dhaibu gu suudai' gu Abraam gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' jix kavɨk dhaibu gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx chɨbɨɨp gu oidha'.

Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tasi' tu' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu vaak mi' dhɨr nukadham gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios duñia' bɨx bhai' ñi'ook na jir bhai' na ba' gu oi'ñga'n jix ai gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Abraam tu' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu ñi'ook gu Sodoma gu Gomorra gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n uañi'ñ tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n jano' gu oi'ñga'n tu' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n tu duukam bhaan tu ñi'ook tu' tɨbiap bɨɨx ka'm tu'; gio ba' tu' cham gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu Sodoma; gu' gu Abraam ka't gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu Abraam; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gio jir bhai' bɨɨx jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu kutun cham tu'x jai'ch mambhɨɨx jir bhai' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook kiicham; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gio cham uañi'ñka' pai' gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx jir bhai' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook koi jir bhai' bɨɨx jix bhai'x ka't jir bhai' gu bhóogɨt na ja'p jix bhai'x; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jir bɨx bhai' bɨx gu oidha' cham tu' gu ñi'ook jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Sodoma mambhɨɨx jir bhai' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook kiicham gu bhóogɨt bɨx dhi' pai' gu ux xoi'kam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abraam jix duñia'; gio ba' gu suudai' jano' kua'da' ñiokda' gu Jawatan gu ux jix duñia' oo' maatai.
Jano' ba' gu kutun jix duñia' mambhɨɨx jir bhai' ja'tkam jixchamaam; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux mii' dhɨr ja'tkam jixchamaam bɨx kiicham jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook oo'm jixchamaam.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' ñiokda'; gio ba' gu kutun gu ñi'ook oo'm; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' cham gu bhóogɨt gu ux xoi'kam oo'm.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n jano' gu Jawatan tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu kutun gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu bhóogɨt tu' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu suudai' jano' gu bhóogɨt ñiokda' gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu kutun gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix aa' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' a'ga; gio ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n jano' gu Jawatan tu' tu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu kutun gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx; jano' ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix aa' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios jix bɨɨx duu ñiokda' gu Abraam; gio ba' gu Abraam jix duñia' pai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gook daada' gu Sodoma gu chuukug gu xumai; gio ba' gu Lot ka't daakat ki'ñgob gu Sodoma; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug gu Lot jix búup tu jiim jix duñia' bhaan gu takarui'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jano' gu Jawatan soi'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu vaak tu duukam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' tɨɨt; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu xibh jix duñia' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham ɨrban gu chuukug dhi' gu tukaa'.
Gu' gu' jix duñia' bɨɨx jix jai' tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx baap gu vaak; gio ba' jix duu gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' cham jabka' koi'mɨk.
Jano' ba' va'k gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu vaak gu chichio'ñ kiicham gu chichio'ñ gu Sodoma bɨx gu ja'tkam ju'ñdharan dɨr gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak bɨɨx ka'm gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' tɨɨt gu Lot gui'p; gio ba' duukat gu chichio'ñ tɨɨtɨs tu' dhi' gu tukaa' gu suudai' na ba' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Lot jix buus ki'ñgob gu ñi'ook kiki'ñgob bhaan.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' soi'ñ gu ja'tkam gu suudai' cham xoi'kam jix duñia' tu' na cham jir bhai'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' jano' tu' no'ñ gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ cham jix duñia' gu tasi' gu chio'ñ; gio ba' jix buusñi gu tasi' xoi'kam na ja'p xoi'kam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ cham xoi'kam cham tu' tɨɨtɨs ɨkgiga'n gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr jix duñia'; jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu ux na ba' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu tanoolh gu oi'ñga'n tu jiim jir bɨx bhai' jano' tu' chulhiiñchuda' gu oi'ñga'n cham bhai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Lot gu ñi'ook na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu novɨ jix duñia' gu Lot gu vaak bɨɨx gu ñi'ook kiki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ mi'p ki'ñgob gu vaak dɨr jix ali' bɨɨx ka'm jix gɨ' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gu' jix duñia' gu ux gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu chichio'ñ gu Lot; gio ba' gu ñi'ook oi'ñdha' gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ bɨx gu ñi'ook kiicham gu suudai' dhi' pai'.
Na gu' na gu' gu chuukug cham tu' duu dhi' pai' na gu' tu ñi'ook tu' jix tɨ'ɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' cham tu' duu.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jix buus gu Lot gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ a'ga jix bhɨɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' pai'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' cham tu' duu dhi' kiicham; gu' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ja'p jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu maa'nkar daada' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Lot bham; na gu' bamii' jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ bakia' na gu' cham gu oi'ñga'n sɨlhka'n kiicham.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ gu ja'tkam gu novɨ gu u'vɨ gu noobh gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ bhaan xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bɨɨx; gio ba' jix duñia' jix dhaas mai' kiicham.

Ba' jix aa' ka't na pai' dhuuk ka't jix buusñi mai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook bɨx dhi' gu bhóogɨt; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk cham ka't gu oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' gu Lot; gio ba' cham tu' soi'ñ gu Jawatan gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' jano' tu' gaagam tu duukam nɨidhidha' gu vupui gu suudai' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu suudai' gu oidha'; gu' tu' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk cham ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt cham bhai' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jano' dhi' kiicham mia'n na ba' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu suudai' jano' cham gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n ii'mdagaram gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu suudai' dho'ñchidhak gio ñi'ook Jawatan bhaan dhi' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiicham tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n; na gu' cham tu' gu oi'ñga'n duñia' bɨɨx ka'm cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ux dhi' ka't tɨɨgim gu tɨɨgɨ' kiicham gu Soar.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tas busaak bhaan gu oidha' na pai' dhuuk gu Lot jix duñia' gu Soar.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Sodoma bhaan gu Gomorra choiñ gu tai baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios dɨr gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jɨ'dɨlh bɨx mii' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx bɨx jix koi mii' dhɨr jɨ'dɨlh gu i'bhɨ gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu Lot jix duñia' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Abraam gu ux gu xibh pai' ka't dhi' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu jiim bhaan gu Sodoma gu Gomorra bhaan bɨx gu oidha' mii' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt tu jiim; gio ba' gu suudai' kuubh jix tɨ'ɨ gu oidha' na ja'p kuubh gu duukam.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu takarui' jɨ'dɨlh gu bhóogɨt tɨ'ñcho gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam bhañ mai' gu Lot tɨjɨɨ'ñ chajaañ gu bhóogɨt jɨ'dɨlh pai' gu Lot ka't.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Lot jix tɨ'ɨ gu Soar jix duñia' gu kavɨk gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ bɨɨx; na gu' jix duñia' ɨɨbhi'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu Soar jix duñia' jumpa'n gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jix gɨ' jix ali'; gio ba' chulhiiñdha' gu taat jix duñia' cham gu jodai' gu chio'ñ gu oidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' gu takarui' bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu kutun gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ i'i suudai' u'va chulhiiñdha' gu taat gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu takarui' chulhiiñdha' gu taat gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix maa i'i suudai' u'va gu taat mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'; gio ba' chɨbiapui jix gɨ' jix koox bɨɨx gu taat; gu' cham jix duñia' duuk jix duñia' tu' duuk jix búup.

Ba' jix aa' gu tanoolh buimgidhak jix gɨ' jix ali'; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' jix koox gu tukaa' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu taat; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt i'i suudai' u'va gio dhi' gu tukaa' ba'k gu jodai' bɨɨx na ba' gu jodai' chulhiiñdha' gu taat gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix maa i'i suudai' u'va gu taat gio mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'; gio ba' jix búup jix ali' jix koox bɨɨx; gu' cham mi'x juu'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ duuk jix duñia' tu' duuk jix búup.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Lot gu taat.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix gɨ' gu mar jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Moab gu taat gu Moabitas bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix ali' gio jix duñia' gu mar jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Ben-ammii gu taat gu Ammonitas bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ta'tak gu Abraam gu oidha' saagi'ñ jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Kades gu Sur jix daa na ja'p ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu Gerar.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abraam gu Saara gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Abimelek gu gɨ'kora' gu Gerar bhañ jix bhɨɨ gu Saara.
Ba' jix aa' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios suudai' u'va gu Abimelek tɨɨtki' gu tukaa'; gio ba' gu suudai' jix koi gu chuukug kuiñcha gu u'vɨ jix bhɨɨ gu takarui' bɨɨx gu chio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Abimelek cham ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jawatan koo'nda' gio gu ja'tkam gu tasi'.
Ba' jix aa' cham; gio ba' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gio jix aa'; jano' ba' xibhɨk bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu noobh gu ñi'ook dhi'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios tɨɨtki'; gio ba' tu' gio tu' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook dhi'; mi' dhɨr tu' gio tu' gu takarui' jix duñia' bhaan tu' cham tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu bhóogɨt gu u'vɨ gu chio'ñ; na gu' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix duñia' gu ux tu' ii'mdagaram; mi' dhɨr tu' cham gu jodai' gu maa'nkar tɨɨda' koi bɨɨx bɨx ka't gu oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abimelek jix búup gu xibh jup tɨɨt bɨx tu duukam bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook maatɨt; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr jup tɨɨt gu Abimelek gu Abraam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt tu' bhaan tu' jix duñia' bhaan tu' bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ cham gu ñi'ook gu Abraam gu ñi'ook gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' gu oi'ñga'n gu Abimelek gu Abraam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' na ba' gu takarui' dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu Abraam jix aa'; na gu' tu ñi'ook na ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr tɨɨda' cham cham tu'x jai'ch choo'n gu Jawatan Dios dhi' pai' yaa' gu ux kuiñcha gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' tu'r gio gu ja'tkam mar u'vɨ gu taat gu' cham mar u'vɨ gu naan jix bhɨɨ gu ux gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' jix duu ka't na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu i'ii'ñ gu vaak gu taat tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' dhi' jix duñia' tu' jix duu bɨx pai' gu chuukug tu'; mi' dhɨr xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Abimelek jix bhɨɨ kakneer gu jodai' tu duukam jix maa gu Abraam jix duñia' gu Saara gu u'vɨ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abimelek; gio ba' gu suudai' gu oidha' vupui bhaan tu' jix daa pai' xoi'kam tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Saara; gio ba' gu suudai' jix maa jix bhai'x gu suudai' jix toja jodai xibhɨk; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' tu' gu ux jix duñia' gu vupui na ba' bɨx bɨndak na ba' bɨɨx bɨx; jano' ba' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Abraam jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Abimelek gu u'vɨ gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' ka't bɨx jix kup gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu takarui' gu vaak gu Abimelek kuiñcha gu Saara gu u'vɨ gu Abraam.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Saara na ja'p ka't tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu Saara na ja'p ka't.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Saara gu Abraam gu mar gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Abraam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu mar jix duñia' gu Saara gu Isaak.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Abraam gu mar gu Isaak gu tasi' gu tanoolh na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Abraam gu ñi'ook gu takarui' na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu Isaak gu mar.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Saara; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt no'x gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix duñia'; gio ba' chɨkka tu ñi'ook gu Abraam gu Saara ka't gu chuukug gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ma'nkam gu bhóogɨt gu mar gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ka't gu takarui'; gio ba' jix duu gu Abraam gu takarui' gu tanoolh ka't gu takarui' gu Isaak.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Saara gu mar gu Agar gu Egipkia ka't gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu Abraam jix duñia'.

Ba' jix aa' gu ux gu jodai' gu Abraam; gio ba' mi'x juu'ñ dhi' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu mar; na gu mar dhi' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios cham tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu mar bɨɨx gu Isaak.
Jano' ba' dhi' tu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Abraam kuiñcha gu mar.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam; gio ba' cham tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a kuiñcha gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios; na gu' bɨx tu' gu takarui' gu Saara gu takarui' gu ñi'ook na gu' gu Isaak tu' ka't mɨmɨim gu ma'nkam.
Na gu' gio gu mar gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam na gu' gu kai'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Abraam jix búup gu bhóogɨt gu xibh jix bhɨɨ gu takarui' gu duukam gu suudai' jix maa gu Agar gu suudai' bhaan gu ñi'ook do'ñcho gu ñi'ook jix duñia'; gio ba' ta'tak jiim gu i'ii'ñ gu ux oidha' jix gaki gu Beer-seba.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu suudai' gu duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨtaa'n gu u'u.

Jano' ba' ka't jix daa gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu Tiro gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ; na gu' chɨtda; na pai' dhuuk cham gu oi'ñga'n na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook jix koi; jano' ba' jix daa gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix kai gu takarui' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jup tɨɨt gu Agar dɨr gu tɨkɨr jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Agar cham jum i'obh; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' naak gu ñi'ook pai'.
Na gu' bamii' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ na gu' gu ja'tkam no'ñ jix dhaas.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix kupi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu vupui jix ñi' suudai' buusñi gu suudai'; gio ba' ka't jix bhuup gu duukam gu suudai' jix maa i'i gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' jix daa oidha' jix gaki ka't gu takarui' u'u gat.
Jano' ba' jix daa oidha' jix gaki gu Paraan; gio ba' gu naan jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Ba' jix aa' ka't mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Abimelek gu Pikol gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Abraam bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios bɨndak bɨx gu jodai' bhaan.

Jano' ba' jano' gu chuukug gu ux gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ta'm na tu maakia' gu Dios tu' gu mar tu' gu ja'tkam; gu' gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' joi'gɨ'nda' tu' gu oi'ñga'n bɨndak jix duu tu' gu chuukug bɨɨx gu oidha' pai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Abraam; gio ba' tu' ñi'ook kavɨk aa'.
Jano' ba' gu Abraam gu suudai' gu Abimelek kuiñcha gu ñi'ook gu suudai' tu duukam gu Abimelek gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Abimelek; gio ba' cham tu' chɨkka ka't gu ñi'ook dhi' tu' gu suudai' tu' gu oi'ñga'n maachim tu' naak bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Abraam kakneer gu jodai' jix maa gu Abimelek; gio ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Abraam kɨɨv ali' karneer kakneer dɨlhkob.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abimelek gu Abraam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix duñia' kɨɨv ali' karneer gu ñi'ook dɨlhkob.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; na dhi' kɨɨv ali' karneer jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ na ba' ka't chuut tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ux dhi' jup tɨɨt mii' dhɨr pai' gu Beer-seba; na gu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Beer-seba; gio ba' jix búup gu Abimelek gu Pikol gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham suulh gu oidha' gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Abraam gu ux gu Beer-seba jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Abraam gu oidha' gu Pilisteos mui'x gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' ka't mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'x vaak zel gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam; gio ba' gu Abraam; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ jano' gu mar gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Isaak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu oidha' gu Moria gu suudai' maa'nkar tai bhaan bhaan maa'n gu kakkavɨk tu' gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' gu Abraam jix búup gu bhóogɨt gu xibh jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ baidhak gook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu Isaak gu mar; gio ba' jix duñia' gu u'u na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan jix búup ka't pai' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'.
Jano' ba' vaik gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu Abraam gu vupui jix ñi' pai' gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abraam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Abraam gu u'u maa'nkar tai bhaan jix dhaas bhaan gu Isaak gu mar; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ gu tai gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook tɨtda:―Aañ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Isaak gu Abraam gu taat; gio ba' gu taat gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu mar; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Miren gu tai gu u'u; gu' duukat mar kaneer na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Abraam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug mar kaneer na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu mar gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' tɨtda:―Aañ.
Jano' ba' jix duu na ja'p jix duñia' pai' gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Abraam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jugi gu u'u jix duñia' gu Isaak gu mar jix dhaas jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan gu u'u.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Abraam gu novɨ jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook na ba' gu tasi' gu mar.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix maa jiiñak gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' gu Abraam; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu novɨ bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook cham tu'; na tu' kakasnira' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham gu chuukug gu mar gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Abraam gu vupui jix duñia' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu chuukug gu ux a'aa'; gio ba' ka't gu Abraam jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook makgɨrxi maa'nkar tai bhaan pai' gu mar.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Abraam gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam gookim jix duñia' dɨr gu tɨkɨr.
Ba' jix aa'; na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na gu' gu ñi'ook dhi' cham gu suudai' gu mar gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' tu' jix bhai' aa' jix mui' gu jodai' gu kai' na ja'p gu si'avag gu tɨkɨr na ja'p oo' jugii'ñ gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' gu kai' gu ñi'ook kiki'ñgob obhɨɨ'ñ.
Na gu' gu kai' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx chɨbɨɨp gu oidha' na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Abraam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix búup jix bɨɨx duu tɨtda:―Aañ gu Beer-seba; gio ba' jix daa gu Abraam gu Beer-seba.
Jano' ba' ka't mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'x ka't gu jodai' gu ja'tkam gu Abraam bham; gio ba' gu Miren gio gu Milka tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ma'nkam gu Nakôr xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' gu us maa'nkam mar gu Bus xibhɨk gu Kemuel gu taat gu Aram.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu aso gu Pildas gu Jidlap gu Betuel.
Jano' ba' gu Betuel jix mar gu Rebeeka; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tasi' jix duñia' gu Milka gu Nakôr xibhɨk gu Abraam.
Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ jup tɨɨt gu Reuuma jix duñia' gio gu Teba gu Gaam gu Taas gu Maakâ.
Jano' ba' ka't gu oidha' gu Saara chamaam gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt jix bɨɨx duu gu takarui' gu oidha' gu Saara.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Saara gu Kiriat-arba gu ebroon gu oidha' gu Kanaan; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu Abraam gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Saara jix xuaak.
Ba' jix aa' jix búup gu Abraam vupui bhaan jix koi gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook bham.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu suudai' gu maa'nkar gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu chuukug jix koi vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu Abraam gui'p.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan gu chuukug gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch; gio ba' tutkɨ air gu chuukug gu ñi'ook jix koi; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch tu' gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu oi'ñga'n jix koi.
Jano' ba' gu Abraam jix búup jix duñia' gu ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' bɨɨx bham; gio ba' tu' namki' aagak tu' gu jodai' jix koi vupui bhaan tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu ux tu' bɨɨx gu Eproon gu mar gu Soar.
Na ba' na ba' jix maa jumpa'n gu Makpela juraa'n gu maa'nkar; na gu ux jir bhai' u'uuk jix maa na ba' gu maa'nkar gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu Eproon gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu et; gio ba' jix aa' gu Eproon gu eteo gu Abraam maatɨt gu ma'nkam gu et bɨx jix duñia' gu ux ki'ñgob kiicham bham.
Jano' ba' cham gu Jawatan gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' tu' gu chuukug gu maa'nkar tu' gu chuukug gio jumpa'n; mi' dhɨr vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam tu' gu chuukug; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix koi.
Jano' ba' gu Abraam jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Eproon maatɨt gu ja'tkam gu oidha' bham; gio ba' va'k tu' gu takarui' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr tu' gu suudai' u'uuk gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook tu' gu chuukug jix koi.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Eproon gu Abraam tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu oidha' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt jix toja jodai; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook dhi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n jix koi.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abraam gu chuukug bɨɨx gu Eproon gu ñi'ook gu Abraam gu Eproon tuumiñ gu takarui' gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt jix toja jodai jix bhai' ñi'ook na tu a'ga tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu maa'nkar gu Eproon ka't gu Makpela gu ñi'ook gu Mamre gu maa'nkar jumpa'n ka't bɨx gu u'u ka't gu maa'nkar bɨx gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu Abraam gu maa'nkar ñiata gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook bɨx jix duñia' gu ux ki'ñgob kiicham.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Abraam gu Saara gu u'vɨ jumpa'n gu maa'nkar gu Makpela gu ñi'ook gu Mamre gu ebroon gu oidha' gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu maa'nkar jumpa'n ka't gu ux gu Abraam gu maa'nkar gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Abraam ka't jix duñia' xoi'kam kia'mi'ñ gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu takarui' gu Abraam bɨx.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abraam jix duñia' gu kutun gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x gu vaak ka't gu ñi'ook bɨx ga'ra'; gio ba' jix dhaas jano' gu novɨ bɨtaa'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu takarui' gu ux gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' cham jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ na ba' gu mar ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Kananeos tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu bhóogɨt.
Gu' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ na ba' gu mar gu Isaak.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix aa'; gio ba' gu kutun gu u'vɨ cham gu suudai' gu kutun gu ñi'ook tu' dhi' gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' gu mar gu oidha' pai' gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abraam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham gu jodai' gu mar.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr jix bhɨɨ gu vaak gu taat gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu kai' gu suudai' dhi' gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook nobii'ñ vupui bhaan tu' jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ na ba' gu mar.
Jano' ba' tu' gu u'vɨ cham gu bhóogɨt gu kutun gu ñi'ook tu' ka' namkidhat dhi' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu suudai' cham gu jodai' gu mar.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' jix dhaas gu novɨ bɨtaa'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Abraam gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook bhaan dhi' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix bhɨɨ mambhɨɨx jix ai gu Jawatan ka't ga'ra' gu jodai' bɨx jix bhai' gu Jawatan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu suudai' kiicham gu Nakôr.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu oi'ñga'n jix ai mai' kiicham ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu tas gu xumai gu tas gɨgɨ'lhi'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jawatan gu Abraam gu bhóogɨt tu' soi'ñ mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vupui xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx gu Jawatan gu Abraam.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' dhi' ju'ñdharan suudai' buusñi gu suudai' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu chichio'ñ dhi' kiicham gɨgɨ'lhi'ñ gu ux gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' ka't gu bhóogɨt tu' gu takarui'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n tu' soi'ñ na ba' tu' gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' i'i gio gu suudai' i'i jix ai; na ka't gu chuukug tu' gu suudai' na ba' tu duukam gu Isaak; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' ka't va'k gu ñi'ook ñiokda' gu suudai' gu Rebeeka ka't maaxir gu Betuel gu mar gu Milka gu u'vɨ gu Nakôr xibhɨk gu Abraam busaak bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt ka't gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ cham ka't gu tasi'; gio ba' jix dhaav suudai' buusñi jix bhuup gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jix duñia' dai'bus bhaan; gio ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug i'i gu vaak gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' i'i gu Jawatan gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr jix maa gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu novɨ jix maa i'i.
Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk jix bɨɨx duu jix duu i'i; gio ba' gio na ba' jix ai jix buusñi gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook i'i.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n dai'bus jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia' gu suudai' jix buusñi na ba' bɨx jix ai.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ ka't gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu chuukug na ba' maachim tu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu bhóogɨt cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p jix ai jix bɨɨx duu i'i jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix uam jodai gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gook gu ux gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' chɨkka gu chuukug mar u'vɨ jix duñia' gu chuukug cham tu'x jai'ch pai' gu vaak gu taat pai' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jix duñia' mar u'vɨ gu Betuel gu mar gu Milka jix duñia' gu Nakôr.
Jano' ba' jix duñia'; gio ba' gio cham tu'x jai'ch gu kutun gu vaak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix jai' gu tasi' pai' na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu takarui' ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' gu Abraam cham jix ai'chdhix xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'r gu takarui' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu ja'tkam gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu bhóogɨt dai'bus maachim gu vaak gu naan dhi' tu'x.
Jano' ba' gu Rebeeka ga'ra' xibhɨk jup tɨɨt gu Labaan dai'bus gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ suudai' buusñi.
Ba' jix aa' ka't na ja'p jix ñi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu noobh gu ja'tkam chɨtda mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ; gio ba' suudai' u'va; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' ka't ju'ñdharan jix ai suudai' buusñi.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jix ai gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu ñi'ook gu jodai' mai' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu vaak pai' na ba' jix ai.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu chio'ñ suudai' u'va gu vaak gu Labaan jix duñia' jix ai; gio ba' jix maa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tasi' gu suudai' na ba' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx aajidha'.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu oi'ñga'n jugi; gu' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham jugi bɨɨx ka'm ka't tu ñi'ook gu chuukug; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Abraam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu takarui' jix jai' gu takarui' tu' gu suudai'; gio ba' tu' jix maa kakneer gu jodai' jix toja jodai jix uam jodai tu duukam jix ai gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Saara gu u'vɨ gu takarui' jix duñia' gu ux gu mar gu Jawatan tu' jix maa bɨx gu jodai' juraa'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu takarui' ñi'ook kavɨk aa' bham; gio ba' cham jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ na ba' gu mar ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Kananeos gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt.
Gu' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu taat gu bhóogɨt jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ na ba' gu mar.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu kutun gu u'vɨ cham gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook nobii'ñ bɨndak gu tasi' gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ na ba' gu mar gu ma'nkam gu vaak gu taat.
Na pai' dhuuk jano' ba' ka' namkidhat gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam; gio ba' tu' cham tu' jix maa ka' namkidhat gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook suudai' buusñi tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jawatan gu Abraam tu' gu tasi' jano' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' dhi' ju'ñdharan suudai' buusñi gu suudai'; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt i'i tu' soi'ñ gu vaak gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook i'i tu' gio na ba' jix ai jix buusñi gu suudai'; gio ba' gu chuukug ka't gu u'vɨ jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu mar gu Jawatan.

Jano' ba' va'k gu ñi'ook ñiokda' gu i'ii'ñ gu suudai' gu Rebeeka busaak bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix dhaav suudai' buusñi jix buusñi gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug i'i.
Ba' jix aa' jix bhai'x jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n tu jiim; gio ba' i'i gio jix ai gu suudai' i'i; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n jix maa gio i'i jix ai.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' chɨkka gu chuukug mar u'vɨ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr mar u'vɨ gu Betuel gu mar gu Nakôr jix duñia' gu Milka; jano' ba' gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan daak gu ux bhaan gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu Jawatan gu Abraam ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu bhóogɨt tu'r na ba' jix bhɨɨ mar u'vɨ xibhɨk gu Jawatan na ba' gu mar.
Jano' ba' jano' tu' jix bhai'x xoi'kam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'r bɨɨx gu Jawatan gu takarui'; gio ba' tu' cham gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr mi'x juu'ñ kɨɨ'n gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Labaan gu Betuel tu ñi'ook gui'p; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook dhi'; mi' dhɨr cham gu takarui' tu ñi'ook cham bhai' tu' jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Rebeeka vupui bhaan tu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug ka't gu u'vɨ gu mar gu Jawatan na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p jix duñia' gu Abraam jix kai gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi jix duñia' gu ux jix toja jodai gu ux jix uam jodai jajannulhi'ñ jix maa gu Rebeeka; gio ba' gio jix maa tu'x a'bhar xibhɨk gu naan.
Jano' ba' koi'mɨk i'i gu chichio'ñ aajidha' bɨɨx jix duñia'; gio ba' kɨkbo gu xibh jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa' xibhɨk gu naan; gio ba' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx no'ch gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gu tanoolh mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook jano' ba'; gio ba' jup tɨɨt gu bhóogɨt tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tɨɨt gu Rebeeka gui'p; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt tu' bɨɨx dhi' gu chio'ñ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu jiim.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' mi'x dhaas tu' gu Rebeeka gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu Abraam gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix bhai' aa' gu Rebeeka gui'p; gio ba' gu kutun gu ja'tkam gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ki'ñgob gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix búup jano' ba' gu Rebeeka gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan jix ai bhiadat gu chio'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' jix bhɨɨ gu Rebeeka ka't.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu Isaak oidha' suudai' na jix do'ig tu'; na gu' jix daa gu oidha' saagi'ñ.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Isaak gu oi'ñga'n yooxi' gu tas gu xumai; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu vupui jix duñia' gu suudai' jix ai aajidha'.
Jano' ba' gu Rebeeka gio jix duñia' gu vupui jix ñi' gu Isaak jix dhaav jix ai.

Na gu' na gu' ka't tu ñi'ook jix duñia'; gio ba' chɨkka dhi' gu chio'ñ jupaabkamu'n gu ux yooxi' bhaan no'ch tu duukam ka't tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Jawatan; jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' jix bhaan dhaas.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Isaak bɨx ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Isaak vaak zel gu naan gu Saara jix bhɨɨ gu Rebeeka gu ux gu u'vɨ; gio ba' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Isaak mi' dhɨr koi'm gu naan.
Jano' ba' gu Abraam jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't gu Ketura.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Simram gu Joksan gu Medan gu Midiam gu Isbak gu Sua.
Jano' ba' gu Joksan jix mar gu Seba gu Dedaan; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Dedaan jix bɨɨx duu gu Assurim gu Letusim gu Leummim.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Midiam; gio ba' gu Epa gu Eper gu Enek gu Abida gu Eldaa; mi' dhɨr bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Ketura.
Jano' ba' gu Abraam jix maa bɨx gu jodai' ga'ra' gu Isaak.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu u'vɨ jix maa gu Abraam juana' bhañ ju'ñdharan gu Isaak gu mar gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan tas buusñi gu oidha' gu ux na tu ibai'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu tanoolh gu oidha' jix oidha' gu Abraam; gio ba' chamaam gu vaak jixchamaam gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix koi gu Abraam jix bhai' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x jix bhuup gu tanoolh ka't maa'n gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Isaak gu Ismael gu ma'nkam jumpa'n gu Makpela gu maa'nkar gu Eproon gu mar gu Soar gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu Mamre.
Jano' ba' gu maa'nkar jugi gu Abraam gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't gu Abraam jix duñia' gu Saara gu u'vɨ.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' mi' dhɨr jix koi gu Abraam gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai' aa' gu Isaak gu mar; gio ba' jix daa gu Isaak ju'ñdharan oidha' suudai' na jix do'ig tu'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu ma'nkam gu Ismael gu mar gu Abraam jix duñia' gu Agar gu Egipkia ja'tkam na tu juan gu Saara.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ma'nkam gu Ismael gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' maa'nkam mar gu Ismael gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu Kedar gu tasi' gu Mibsam.
Jano' ba' gu Duma gu Massa.
Jano' ba' gu adad gu Tema gu Jetur gu Napis gu Kedema.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Ismael dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu ux vaak ja'tkam; gio ba' gu kutun chiñia' gu ux gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu takarui' gu oidha' gu Ismael chamaam gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu takarui'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Ismael jix koi; mi' dhɨr ka't maa'n gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' dɨr gu abila bɨɨx ka'm gu Sur gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto bai'ñpu' gu Asiria; gio ba' jix koi gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu ma'nkam gu Isaak gu mar gu Abraam; gio ba' gu Abraam jix mar gu Isaak.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Isaak oo'm gu takarui' na pai' dhuuk jix bhɨɨ gu ux gu u'vɨ gu Rebeeka mar u'vɨ gu Betuel gu Arameo gu Padan-aram gu ja'tkam gu Labaan gu Arameo.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Isaak gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu u'vɨ ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Rebeeka gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam jugi gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' na ba' gu ñi'ook tu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gook chɨbɨɨp cham tu'x jai'ch baaso gook gu ja'tkam ka't gu takarui' dɨr ba'k; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam ka't gu oi'ñga'n jix kavɨk gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' tu juan jix ali'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix duñia' gu tanoolh na ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu takarui' vook.
Jano' ba' jix buus maa'n gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu suudai' na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Esauu.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix buus xibhɨk gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ gu ñi'ook gu Esauu; gio ba' ka't tɨɨgim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jakob; na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Isaak gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu takarui' na pai' dhuuk jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook a'aalh gu Esauu ka't gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ yooxi'; gio ba' gu Jakob cham gu ñi'ook ka't gu chio'ñ gu suudai' jix daa vaak zel.
Na gu' jix duñia' gu Isaak gu Esauu na gu' jugi gu ñi'ook; gu' gu Rebeeka dha'da' gu Jakob.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jakob gu suudai'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Esauu yooxi' jix bhai'x.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jakob; gio ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug jugi gu ñi'ook dhi' gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x; na ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' ka't tɨɨgim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Edom.
Jano' ba' gu Jakob jix aa'; gio ba' gu suudai' dhi' gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Esauu; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ koi; mi' dhɨr na ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jakob; gio ba' gu chuukug dhi' gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jakob gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Jakob jix maa gu Esauu gu takarui' gu chuukug gu ux; gio ba' jix jugi jix i'i jix búup ka't; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Esauu gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' ka't bhiogi' gu oidha' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook bhiogi' ka't gu tanoolh gu Abraam; gio ba' ka't gu Isaak gu Abimelek gu gɨ'kora' gu Pilisteos gu Gerar.
Ba' jix aa' jix ñi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu bhóogɨt gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha' tu' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu abita dhi' gu oidha' jix duñia' bɨndak tu' jix bhai' aa'; na gu' tu' gu kai' gu suudai' bɨx dhi' oi'ñga'n gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu Abraam gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu kai' na ja'p gu si'avag gu tɨkɨr gu suudai' gu kai' bɨx dhi' oi'ñga'n; gio ba' bɨx chɨbɨɨp gu oidha' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kai'.
Na gu' na gu' jix kai gu Abraam gu ñi'ook nukadham gu chuukug gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Jano' ba' jix daa gu Isaak gu Gerar.

Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ mii' dhɨr pai' tɨkka gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam; na gu' jix duñia' ɨɨbhi'ñ a'ga; gio ba' gu u'vɨ; na jix duñia' jix aa' gu chichio'ñ pai' kooda' gu ux kuiñcha gu Rebeeka; na gu' ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' mi' dhɨr juruuñ mui'x gu tanoolh gu Abimelek gu gɨ'kora' gu Pilisteos tɨɨgɨk gu ux gu ñi'ook jix ñi' gu Isaak jix duñia' bɨɨx gu Rebeeka gu u'vɨ.

Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt gu Abimelek gu Isaak; gio ba' gu suudai' tɨɨda' gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu Isaak jix aa'; na gu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu kutun koi gu ux kuiñcha.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abimelek; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ux gu vaak gu ñi'ook jix koox oi'ñdha' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu u'vɨ gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' bhaan no'ch uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Abimelek jix aa'ñdhix bɨx gu ja'tkam bham; na gu suudai' dhi' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ tɨɨda' koi.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Isaak mii' dhɨr gu oidha' gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr oi'ñga' chamaam gu ux maa'n; gio ba' jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ jix duñia' ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu duukam kakneer gu duukam gu jodai' jix gɨ' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu Pilisteos chooto'n jɨɨgak.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix kupi'ook gu suudai' gu Abraam gu taat gu tanoolh gu Pilistese gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abimelek gu Isaak; na gu' gu takarui' no'ch na gu' jix jai' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook no'ch tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Isaak ka't; gio ba' jix duñia' vaak zel gu suudai' gu Gerar jix daa.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' bhi'spio'kai gu Isaak gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix kupi'ook gu tanoolh gu Abraam gu taat gu Pilisteos gu suudai' jix koi gu Abraam; gio ba' jup tɨɨt gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gu taat ka't tɨɨgim.
Jano' ba' tu duukam gu Isaak jix duñia' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' bipia'dam gu Gerar gu suudai' bɨɨx bipia'dam gu Isaak bham; gio ba' gu suudai' gu kutun; na gu' gu ux gu ñi'ook jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook gu Esek na gu' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gio gu suudai' bhaan; gio ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Sitna.
Jano' ba' jix ai'chdhix jix kupi'ook gu ñi'ook cham gu suudai' bhaan; gio ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Reobot jix aa'; na gu' jano' tu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Beer-seba.

Ba' jix aa' jix ñi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam gu taat; mi' dhɨr cham jum i'obh tu' jix duñia' bɨndak tu' jix bhai' aa' gu jodai' gu kai' gu ux xoi'kam gu Abraam tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jix duu jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' vaak zel; gio ba' jix duñia' tu duukam gu Isaak gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Abimelek suudai' u'va dɨr gu Gerar gu Aussat gu ja'tkam gu kutun gu Pikol gu suudai' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Ba' jix aa' gu Isaak; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jupaabkamu'n tu' jix duñia' gu jodai' mi'x juu'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu jodai' buupui gu Jawatan Dios bɨndak; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' ka't jano' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch tu' chulhiiñchuda' ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨndak.
Na cham gu ñi'ook cham bhai' na ja'p no'ch cham tu' gu jodai' dhaa na ja'p gu suudai' tu' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam tu' gu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ; gio ba' tu' jano' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu takarui' koi'mɨk i'i.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook maa'n; gio ba' gu Isaak jix duñia' bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix duñia' tɨɨtɨs gu suudai' gu Isaak jix maa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix kupi'ook gui'p; gio ba' gu suudai' gu jodai' gaagam.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Seba; gio ba' gu ux kuiñcha gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr kiicham gu Beer-seba bɨɨx ka'm dhi' gu tanoolh.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Esauu ka't oo'm gu takarui' jix bhɨɨ gu ux gu u'vɨ gu Judit mar u'vɨ gu Beeri gu takarui' gu Basemat mar u'vɨ gu Eloon gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Isaak gu Rebeeka.
Ba' jix aa' ka't na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Isaak gu chuukug gu vupui jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt cham ñiata jup tɨɨt gu Esauu gu mar jix gɨ'; gio ba' gu mar; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' jix duñia' cham tu' gu tanoolh koi'm.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jano' gu ñi'ook jix buus yooxi' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug na ja'p tu' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n jugi; na ba' tu' gu jodai' gu i'ii'ñ va'k gu jodai'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu Rebeeka ka't tɨiñ na pai' dhuuk ua'rgidhimɨk gu Isaak gu Esauu gu mar; gio ba' ka't gu Esauu yooxi' na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook ka't gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Rebeeka gu Jakob gu mar bham; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' naak gu taat ua'rgidhimɨk bɨɨx gu Esauu xibhɨk bham.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu chuukug na ba' jugi tu' gu jodai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios va'k tu' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu mar gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook tu' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' tu' jano' gu vaakax gu oi'ñga'n gook jix bhai' gu bhóogɨt koi' na ba' gu taat na ja'p gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' tu' gu jodai' gu taat jugi na ba' tu' gu jodai' va'k koi'm.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jakob gu Rebeeka gu naan; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Esauu xibhɨk gu chio'ñ jix bhai'x tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu kutun vaak zel gu taat gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu suudai' gu jodai' bhaan tu' mu'ai cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu naan jix aa'; gio ba' gu mar gu chuukug bhaan tu' mu'ai; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook tu' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka't jix bhɨɨ gu naan; gio ba' gu naan jix duu gu takarui' na ja'p gu taat jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Rebeeka jajannulhi'ñ gu Esauu gu mar jix gɨ' gu takarui' ga'ra' gu vaak jix duñia' gu Jakob gu mar jix ali'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook bhaan gu noobh bhaan gu suudai' pai' cham ga'ra' gu bhóogɨt tɨɨt gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' do'ñcho gu takarui' ka't gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ gu Jakob gu mar.
Ba' jix aa' ka't gu taat; gio ba' gu taat gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt chɨkka gu chuukug gu mar gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jakob gu taat; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Esauu maa'nkam mar; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook na ja'p tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' bamii' jano' xanoop jugi gu ñi'ook na ba' gu jodai' gu i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Isaak gu mar; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bakia' gu ñi'ook jootom gu mar gu chuukug jix aa'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu jodai' vupui bhaan tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Isaak gu Jakob; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt jano' tu' gu chuukug gu mar gu chuukug gu ñi'ook tu' gu chuukug gu mar gu Esauu cham.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jakob gu taat gu Isaak; gio ba' jix duñia' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jakob gu' gu noobh gu Esauu.
Na gu' cham jix duñia' na gu' gu noobh jix duñia' gu takarui' na ja'p gu noobh gu Esauu; gio ba' jix bhai' aa'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu chuukug tu' gu mar gu Esauu jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jugi gu ñi'ook gu mar na ba' tu' gu jodai' gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix jugi; jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio suudai' u'va jix i'i.
Ba' jix aa' gu Isaak gu taat; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt jano' gu chuukug gu mar gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Isaak gu ñi'ook jajannulhi'ñ jix bhai' aa' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu mar na ja'p gu ñi'ook yooxi' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu suudai' gu tɨkɨr gu jodai' gu oidha' gu ñi'ook tiriik gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook tu'; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt tu' gu ma'nkam gu naan; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' tu' gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Isaak gu ñi'ook jix bhai' aa' gu Jakob gu chuukug ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jakob vupui bhaan gu Isaak gu taat gu Esauu xibhɨk suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jix duu gio gu takarui' jix bhɨɨ gu taat; gio ba' gu jodai' gu taat jugi gu ñi'ook gu mar na ba' gu jodai' gu i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Isaak gu taat; gio ba' chɨkka gu chuukug tu' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu mar maa'nkam mar gu Esauu.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu Isaak bɨɨx jix gɨ' jix duñia'; gio ba' chɨkka suudai' u'va jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ jugi bɨx va'k gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu Esauu jix kai gu ñi'ook gu taat tu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' gu bhóogɨt gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu jodai'; gio ba' gu suudai' gio tu' gu taat gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' suudai' u'va xibhɨk bɨɨx iatda' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' xoi'kam tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jakob tu' gu suudai' gook mui'kim; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' jano' tu' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham nukadham gu ñi'ook na ba' tu'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Isaak gu Esauu; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Jawatan gu oi'ñga'n jix maa gu ux tu duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr tiriik suudai' u'va gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu bhóogɨt tu' jano' gu mar gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu Esauu jix aa' gu taat; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu duukam gu ñi'ook gu taat gu chuukug gu suudai' gio tu' gu taat gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Esauu gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Isaak gu taat; gio ba' gu suudai' ka't ba'bhak gu jodai' gu oidha' gu suudai' gu tɨkɨr jiix.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu kuchii ii'mdagaram xibhɨk gu bhóogɨt; na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug na pai' dhuuk tu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu tasi' gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu Esauu gu Jakob gu ux gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka't gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tanoolh gu chuukug gu taat tu' kooda' gu Jakob xibhɨk.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu tu ñi'ook gu Rebeeka gu ñi'ook gu Esauu gu mar jix gɨ'; gio ba' bhañ jup tɨɨt gu Jakob gu mar jix ali' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu Esauu xibhɨk gu takarui' gu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx gu suudai' kooda'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu mar gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bamii' gu chuukug gu Labaan xibhɨk jix duu.
Jano' ba' jix koi bɨɨx dhɨt gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm gu duukam xibhɨk gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu oi'ñga'n daak xibhɨk bhaan tu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n jano' ba' tu' gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh.

Ba' jix aa' gu Rebeeka gu Isaak; gio ba' gu suudai' no'ñ gu oidha' kuiñcha ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jakob jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu suudai' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ dhi' gu oidha' na ba' gu ñi'ook pai'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Isaak jup tɨɨt gu Jakob jix bhai' aa' bham; gio ba' cham jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' bamii' tu' gu Padan-aram gu vaak gu Betuel gu taat gu naan jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Labaan xibhɨk gu naan.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' tu' gu jodai' tu' gu oi'ñga'n jix mui' jum duu tu' gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm gu kutun gu suudai' gu takarui' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu' jix maa gu ñi'ook gu Abraam gu kai' bɨndak na ba' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu Abraam.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Isaak gu Jakob ka't gu Padan-aram gu Labaan gu mar gu Betuel gu Arameo xibhɨk gu Rebeeka gu naan gu Jakob gu Esauu.

Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Esauu gu ñi'ook gu Isaak ka't gu takarui' gu Jakob ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Padan-aram na ba' jix bhɨɨ na ba' gu u'vɨ; na pai' dhuuk jix bhai' aa' ka't jix aa'ñdhix bham; mi' dhɨr cham jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' gu Jakob ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu taat gu naan ka't gu ja'tkam gu Padan-aram.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu suudai' gu Esauu ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Kanaan gu suudai' cham bhai' gu Isaak gu taat.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Esauu gu Ismael jix bhɨɨ na ba' gu ux gu u'vɨ gu Maalet mar u'vɨ gu Ismael gu mar gu Abraam gu ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu Jakob gu Beer-seba ka't jix duu.
Na gu' jix duñia' bɨɨx pai' jix koox na gu' tu' gu tas ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu jodai mii' dhɨr gu suudai' jix dhaas gu vaak jix duñia' mii' dhɨr pai'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu jodai' ka't gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' mo'o gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' gu suudai' daada' gu Jawatan Dios jix tɨ'ɨ jix dhaav gu ux.

Ba' jix aa' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhai'x; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam gu taat gu Jawatan Dios gu Isaak; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' gu jodai' jix duñia' tu' gu suudai' tu' gu kai'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu kai' na ja'p oo' gu oidha' tu' gu suudai' tas gei'ñ tas buusñi gu ñi'ook saagi'ñ; gio ba' bɨx ja'tkam vaak gu oidha' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu kai'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' jix duñia' bɨndak tu' nukadham gu ux pai' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook tu' gu jodai' dhi' gu oidha'; na gu' cham tu' mi'x dhaas bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' ka't gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu Jakob koox; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dhi' pai' tu' cham bhai'x.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' ɨɨbhi'ñ; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook dhi' pai' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ki'ñgob gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Jakob gu xibh jix bhɨɨ gu jodai ka't gu ñi'ook gu vaak jix duñia' gu ux mo'bon ja'aa bɨ'ñdhatu' tu jiim.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu Bet-el xoi'kam gu tasi' ka't gu tɨɨgɨ' kiicham maa'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jakob gu tasi' bham; gio ba' tu' ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug nukadham dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix maa gu takarui' na ba' jugi tɨi'chu' na ba' kutun.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu vaak gu taat gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu jodai gu ñi'ook gu ux mo'bon ka't gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bɨx gu chuukug mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook na ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' chɨ'ɨɨk gu Jakob gu bhóogɨt ka't gu oidha' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix ñi' gu ñi'ook yooxi'; gio ba' gu suudai' vaik kakneer gu takarui' mia'n; na gu' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu suudai'; jano' ba' ka't gu jodai bhaan gu chin gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx kakneer; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai bhaan gu chin gu ñi'ook kakneer; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu jodai bhaan gu chin gu ñi'ook pai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jakob; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu suudai' duukat tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duu gu'ch.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu duukam gu Labaan gu mar gu Nakôr gui'p; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' juraa'n bhai'x i'ii'ñ gui'p; mi' dhɨr bhai'x i'ii'ñ; jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Rakêl mar u'vɨ jupaabkamu'n bɨɨx gu vaakax.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu suudai' gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jix duu gu vaakax; jano' ba' jix duñia' kakneer gu bhóogɨt gu ux.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu chuukug bɨx gu suudai' gu jodai bhaan gu chin gu ñi'ook na ba' gu jodai' kakneer.
Na gu' kua' gu ñi'ook a'gi'ñchu' bɨɨx gu Rakêl suudai' u'va bɨɨx gu vaakax gu taat na gu' ka't gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' na ja'p gu Jakob jix ñi' gu Rakêl mar u'vɨ gu Labaan xibhɨk gu naan kakneer gu Labaan xibhɨk gu naan jix duñia' gu Jakob jix duñia' gu jodai bhaan gu chin gu ñi'ook gu vaakax gu Labaan xibhɨk gu naan.
Jano' ba' gu Jakob gu chuukug gu Rakêl jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jakob gu Rakêl na ja'p ka't xibhɨk gu taat na ja'p ka't gu mar gu Rebeeka; gio ba' dai'bus jix maa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu taat.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu Labaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jakob gu mar gu ja'tkam dai'bus tu jiim jix duñia' gu chuukug jix bhɨɨ gu vaak; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Labaan bɨx dhi' tu'x.
Ba' jix aa' gu Labaan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook o'o gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr juruuñ bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Labaan gu Jakob; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' tu' xibhɨk tu juan gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Labaan ga'ra' gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' jix gɨ' ka't gu Leea gu tɨɨgɨ' jix ali' gu Rakêl.
Jano' ba' gu vupui gu Leea jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu' gu Rakêl ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jakob jix duñia' gu Rakêl; gio ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt kɨɨv gu takarui' gu ux gu Rakêl mar u'vɨ jix ali'.
Jano' ba' gu Labaan jix aa'; gio ba' tutkɨ tu' jix maa tu' cham jix maa gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr tu' gu chuukug.
