Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jakob gu ux gu Rakêl kɨɨv gu takarui'; na gu' jix duñia' na ja'p gu jodai' gu tanoolh na gu' dha'da'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jakob gu Labaan; na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu u'vɨ na gu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' na ba' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu Labaan jum daa'ñ bɨx gu chichio'ñ mii' dhɨr pai' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tukaa' jix bhɨɨ gu Leea mar u'vɨ jix bhɨɨ; gio ba' chɨbiapui.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Labaan ja'tkam na tu juan gu Silpa mar u'vɨ gu Leea gu ux gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios.
Jano' ba' namkia' gu xibh gu suudai' ka't gu Leea; gio ba' jix aa' gu Labaan; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook cham tu' jix duñia' gu ux gu Rakêl gu ux gu ñi'ook gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu Labaan jix aa'; gio ba' cham duñia' chulhiiñdha' pai' jix maa jix ali' va'k jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' kia'pɨx gu chuukug tu' maa'n gio gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu chuukug kɨɨv gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jakob jix duñia' kia'pɨx gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jix maa gu Rakêl mar u'vɨ gu ux gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Labaan gu Rakêl mar u'vɨ gu ux gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios ja'tkam na tu juan gu Bila.
Jano' ba' chɨbiapui gio gu Rakêl; gio ba' jix duñia' gio gu oi'ñga'n gu Leea; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Jawatan Dios gu Leea ka't gu chuukug jix kupi'ook gu takarui'; gu' gu Rakêl ka't gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu Leea jix duñia' gu mar jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Rubeen na gu'; na gu' tu' tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr jano' gu ux gu jodai' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu mar; na gu' jix kai gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't gu chuukug tu' jix maa gio gu ux; mi' dhɨr jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Simeoon.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu mar; na gu' jano' dhi' jix duñia' maa'n gu chio'ñ gu chuukug na gu' gu bhóogɨt vaik gu ma'nkam; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Lebii.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu mar; gio ba' dhi' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ux dhi' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Judaa; jano' ba' mi'x dhaas gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Rakêl cham jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Jakob jix duñia' jɨɨgak gu ja'tkam chɨtda gu Jakob; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ma'nkam tu' cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jakob jix duñia' bhaan gu Rakêl chɨtda; gio ba' jix duñia' tu' pai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' gu i'bhɨ vook.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu suudai' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu Bila; mi' dhɨr ba'k jix mar bhaan kɨkbok tu' gio gu oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Bila ja'tkam na tu juan gu ux gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu Jakob chɨbiapui.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Bila jix duñia' gu Jakob gu mar.
Ba' jix aa' gu Rakêl; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gio jix kai gu ñi'ook jix maa gu mar; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Dan.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Bila ja'tkam na tu juan gu Rakêl jix duñia' gu mar gook gu Jakob.
Ba' jix aa' gu Rakêl; gio ba' bɨɨx gu kutun gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Leea ka't tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ gu Silpa ja'tkam na tu juan jix maa gu Jakob gu ux gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu Silpa ja'tkam na tu juan gu Leea jix duñia' gu Jakob gu mar.
Ba' jix aa' gu Leea; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Gad.
Jano' ba' gu Silpa ja'tkam na tu juan gu Leea jix duñia' gu mar gu Jakob.
Ba' jix aa' gu Leea; na ba' tu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' gu u'vɨ gu chuukug tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Aser.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Rubeen gu ñi'ook oraa' gu ñi'ook jix aa'ñdhix yooxi' jix bhɨɨ gu Leea gu naan; gio ba' jix aa' gu Rakêl gu Leea; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu chuukug jix aa'ñdhix gu mar.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham tu'x jai'ch jix bhɨɨ gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gio tu' gu suudai' jix aa'ñdhix gu mar gu Rakêl; na gu' jix koox bɨndak dhi' gu tukaa' gu ux jix aa'ñdhix gu mar.
Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk gu Jakob gu ñi'ook yooxi' gu xumai jix buus gu Leea; na gu' tu' baakɨi na gu' tu'r tu' gu chuukug gu ux jix aa'ñdhix gu mar; mi' dhɨr jix koox bɨɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu Jawatan Dios gu Leea; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jakob jixchamaam gu mar.
Ba' jix aa' gu Leea; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu ñi'ook na gu' tu' ja'tkam na tu juan gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu ñi'ook jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Issakâr.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Leea jix duñia' xijumai gu mar gu Jakob.
Ba' jix aa' gu Leea; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa jix bhai' jix duñia'; na gu' jano' jix koi gu chuukug gu chio'ñ na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu ma'nkam; jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix duñia' mar u'vɨ jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Dina.
Jano' ba' tɨ'ñcho gu Jawatan Dios gu Rakêl jix kai gu Jawatan Dios jix kupi'ook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu mar; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Josee bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu mar.
Ba' jix aa' ka't na pai' dhuuk gu Rakêl ka't gu bhóogɨt gu Josee gu Jakob gu Labaan; gio ba' gu jodai' tu jiim pai' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam gu ux jix duñia' bɨndak gu takarui' tu'; na gu' tu' ñɨidhat gu takarui' tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Labaan jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jano' nɨidhidha' gu vupui tu' gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook kuiñcha.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' ñɨidhat gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' dhi' gu vaakax gu chuukug.

Na gu' na gu' gu vaak gu bhóogɨt va'k namkia' tu' gu oi'ñga'n jɨɨ'ñdhidha'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu takarui' bɨɨx gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr jano' duuk no'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' gio gu ux gu suudai' gu vaak.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu suudai' jix aa' gu Jakob; mi' dhɨr cham gu chuukug cham tu'; jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux tu' dhi' gu jodai' gu chuukug kakneer.

Jano' ba' tu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu ux bɨx kakneer gu takarui' dɨlhkob bɨx gu jodai' gu chuukug jix uam gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu jodai' jix uam jix bhai'x tɨjɨɨ'ñ kakneer gu chuukug jix uam gu oi'ñga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' dhi' ka't gu bhóogɨt.

Na pai' dhuuk tu ñi'ook gu ux tu' bɨx bhai' gu xibh na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan tu'; gio ba' bɨx cham ka't gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook jix uam jix bhai'x kakneer gu suudai' tu' mambhɨɨx gu ux.
Ba' jix aa' gu Labaan; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jum duu na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix ai'chdhix mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu oi'ñga'n chiiw gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug; gio ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu chuukug jix uam gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu jodai' ga'ra' gu ñi'ook jix toja bɨx jix uam jix bhai'x tɨjɨɨ'ñ kakneer jix dhaas gu noobh gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas vaik gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jakob; gio ba' gu Jakob jix duñia' kakneer gu Labaan.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Jakob gu kutun gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu jodai' chooto gu ñi'ook jix toja gu kutun.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu kutun ka't gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan gu vaakax gu maa'nkar gu suudai' pai' aajidha' i'i kakneer jix duñia' bai'ñpu' i'i.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' kakneer vupui bhaan gu kutun gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' jix uam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jakob kaneer gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx kakneer jix bhai'x bɨx ka't jix bhai'x gu duukam gu Labaan; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu duukam dɨlhkob cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx kakneer gu Labaan.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu suudai' mui'kim jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu Jakob gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kutun vupui bhaan kakneer gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu jodai' ñiata gu kutun.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk aajidha' kakneer gu suudai' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' gu suudai' na ba' gu Labaan gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu Jakob.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt jix jai' jix duñia' mumua'da' kakneer tu duukam jix ai gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Labaan am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' gu Jakob tu' jix bhɨɨ bɨx ka't chulhiiñdha' gu taat; mi' dhɨr ka't chulhiiñdha' gu taat tu' gu jodai' bɨx dhi' gu duukam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gio gu Jakob gu suudai' gu Labaan gu chuukug cham ka't na ba' bɨɨx na ja'p gu ñi'ook va'k gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gio gu Jawatan Dios gu Jakob; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' tattat gu bhóogɨt; na tu' jix duñia' bɨndak.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Jakob jup tɨɨt gu Rakêl gu Leea yooxi' kakneer.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu jodai' gu suudai' gu taat cham na ba' gu chuukug na ja'p gu ñi'ook va'k gu ñi'ook; gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu taat tu' jix duñia' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu taat tu' gu suudai' tu' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx mui'kim; gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' gu takarui' gu jodai' cham bhai'.

Jano' ba' tu' chɨtda; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' bɨx kakneer gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' tu' chɨtda; gio ba' jix bhai'x ka't gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' bɨx kakneer gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaakax gu taat jix maa tu'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook kakneer jix duñia' gu chuukug tu' gu vupui tu' tɨɨtki' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu u'vɨ jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tɨɨtki'; gio ba' gu Jakob; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jano' gu vupui gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt kakneer jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu takarui'; na gu' tu' buupui bɨx gu Labaan tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Bet-el pai' tu' maa'n mo'bon pai' gu oi'ñga'n gu tasi'; gio ba' bamii' jano' jix buus dhi' gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Rakêl gu Leea gui'p; gio ba' tañia' tu' baasɨ'n tu' gu maa'nkar gu vaak chulhiiñdha' gu taat.
Jano' ba' cham juraa'n tu' na ja'p gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu suudai' tu' jugi bɨx chulhiiñdha' u'uuk.
Na gu' na gu' bɨx gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n chulhiiñdha' gu taat gu kutun taata'n gu ma'nkam; gio ba' jano' gu vupui bɨx gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup gu Jakob jix tɨ'ɨ gu ma'nkam gu u'vɨ bhaan jix ai.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu vaakax bɨx gu i'ii'ñ ka't gu jodai' gu vaakax jix duñia' ka't gu chuukug gu Padan-aram na ba' jix joi'ñ gu Isaak gu taat gu oidha' gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' gu Labaan ka't gu ja'tkam bhaan kakneer; gio ba' gu Rakêl jix duñia' duiñxim gu taat.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jakob gu i'ii'ñ gu Labaan gu Arameo cham jix duñia' maachim gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx bɨx ga'ra'; gio ba' jix búup gu ñi'ook gɨ' suudai' jiim jix dhaas gu vupui gu kavɨk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Labaan vaik gu tanoolh na ja'p gu Jakob ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ja'tkam baidhak ka't bhaan gu bhóogɨt kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu kavɨk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu Jawatan Dios gu Labaan gu Arameo tɨɨtki' mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham tu ñi'ook gu Jakob jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Labaan gu Jakob gu ux ka't gu chuukug vaak zel gu kavɨk; gio ba' gu Labaan jix dhaas bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu kavɨk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Labaan gu Jakob; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu jodai' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ na ja'p gu suudai' bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook tu' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook cham chɨɨdak gu bhóogɨt na ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu kutun bɨɨx xoi'kam bɨɨx gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n.
Na gu suudai' cham mi'x dhaas gu chuukug gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; gio ba' jano' jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' cham tu'x jai'ch gu novɨ na ba' duñia' cham bhai'; gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu taat tu ñi'ook jix bhai'x bham; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham tu ñi'ook gu Jakob jix bhai'x.
Na gu' tu' gu suudai' na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu taat gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jakob gu Labaan; na gu' jix duñia' ɨɨbhi'ñ; na gu' tu ñi'ook gu kutun gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu kavɨk ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham gu tai; gio ba' vupui bhaan xibhɨk gu ja'tkam gu takarui' tu' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu Jakob cham bhai'x gu Rakêl ka't gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' chɨbiapui gu Labaan vaak zel gu Jakob vaak zel gu Leea vaak zel gook gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios cham gu ñi'ook jix buus vaak zel gu Leea suudai' u'va vaak zel gu Rakêl.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Rakêl duiñxim jix dhaas gu bhóogɨt jix ai jix daa bhaan; gio ba' vaak zel gu Labaan bɨx vaak zel cham gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' gu taat; na gu' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan na gu' cham gu takarui' jix búup vupui bhaan tu'; na gu' dhi' bɨɨx gu takarui' gu u'vɨ; jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu' cham gu ñi'ook duiñxim.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Jakob bhaam jix suudai' duu bɨɨx gu Labaan; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jakob gu Labaan; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ bɨɨx gu jodai' gu takarui' tɨbiap gu chuukug.
Na gu' oilhimɨk bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gaagam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu vaak jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam gu jodai' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu takarui' dhi' bɨndak; gio ba' kakneer gu ñi'ook cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' tu' jugi gu ñi'ook kakneer.
Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk tu' jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu tanoolh na ja'p gu tukaa' gu novɨ gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix tónom gu tukaa' gu bhóogɨt koox gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vupui.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu vaak; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ux gu takarui' gu ux gu vaakax; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx mui'kim.

Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu taat gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam choo'n gu Isaak cham mai' gu chuukug tɨɨda' gu takarui' jano' cham tu'x jai'ch; gio ba' jix ñi' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' tu jiim gu noobh tu' jix duñia' jix bhai'x.

Ba' jix aa' gu Labaan gu Jakob; gio ba' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu suudai' gu ma'nkam gu suudai' kakneer bɨx tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu takarui' tu' bhaan gu ñi'ook dhi' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ma'nkam jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu kutun jano' jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan tu'; gio ba' ka't chuut tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Jakob jix bhɨɨ gu jodai jix búup gu ux mo'bon.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jakob gu ja'tkam; gio ba' jix duñia' gu jodai; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu jodai jix duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' koi'mɨk bhaan mii' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Labaan gu Jegar gu duukam; gio ba' jup tɨɨt gu Jakob gu Galaad.
Ba' jix aa' na gu' gu Labaan; gio ba' dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tasi' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu ñi'ook ka't tɨɨgim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Galaad.
Ba' jix aa' gu Mispa na gu'; na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook maa'n.
Jano' ba' tu' gu suudai' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ tu' jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ gu suudai' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ soo'mchulhdhak bɨɨx no'ch; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios gu tasi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu oi'ñga'n gu Labaan gu Jakob; gio ba' gu suudai' dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' dhi' mo'bon gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tasi' ka't dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tasi' ka't dhi' mo'bon tu' gu suudai' bhaan tu' dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu suudai' bhaan tu' dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' dhi' mo'bon na ba' cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam gu Jawatan Dios gu Nakôr gu jodai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch gu Jawatan Dios tattat; gio ba' gu Jakob gu ñi'ook gu ux choo'n gu Isaak gu taat.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Jakob jix duñia' gu suudai' gu kavɨk jup tɨɨt gu ja'tkam jugi gu takarui'; gio ba' koi'mɨk gu takarui' jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' gu kavɨk.
Ba' jix aa' jix búup gu Labaan gu xibh jix duñia' gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ jix bhai' aa'; gio ba' jix duñia' pai'.
Jano' ba' gu Jakob ka't gu bhóogɨt moor gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ daada' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jakob na pai' dhuuk jix ñi'; gio ba' yooxi' gu Jawatan Dios dhi'; mi' dhɨr jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu Maanaim.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Jakob gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu Esauu xibhɨk gu oidha' gu Seir yooxi' gu Edom.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix bham; gio ba' gu chuukug gu Jawatan gu Esauu; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook tu duukam gu Jakob; jano' ba' bɨɨx gu Labaan jix koi gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm jano'.
Jano' ba' no'ñ gu jodai' buur kakneer tu duukam; gio ba' jootsa' a'ga gu Jawatan gu ux gu ñi'ook nɨidhidha' gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' suulh gu Jakob bham; gio ba' sɨlh xibhɨk gu Esauu gio jupaabkamu'n gu oi'ñga'n gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Jakob jix duñia' choo'n jix duñia'; gio ba' ta'tak gu ja'tkam ga'ra' baidhak kakneer gu jodai' jix ai gook gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu Esauu gu chuukug jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jakob; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu taat gu Abraam gu Jawatan Dios gu taat gu Isaak gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu bhóogɨt xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' jix ali' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam bɨx tu'r gu chuukug na ba' bɨɨx tu duukam; na bɨɨx gu suudai' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu Jordaan jano' dhi' bhaan gook gu chuukug.
Na gu' gu suudai' jano' gu novɨ xibhɨk gu novɨ gu Esauu na gu' gu takarui'; gio ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu kutun gu oi'ñga'n gu naan bɨɨx gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Yo tu' gu bhóogɨt xoi'kam gu bhóogɨt gu kai' na ja'p oo' gu gɨ' suudai' cham jɨ'xdha' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n.
