Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n chiiw gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n chiiw gu oi'ñga'n kakneer gu ñi'ook gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix ai gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ma'nkam oo'm gu jodai' mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook buur mambhɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' do'ñcho gu novɨ tu duukam gu jodai' gu ux; gio ba' jix aa' tu duukam; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' vupui bhaan tu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix maa'n bham; gio ba' tu' gu Esauu xibhɨk tu' gu oi'ñga'n tu' tu ñi'ook bham; mi' dhɨr chɨkka gu chuukug gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' chɨkka dhi' gu suudai' vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' daipu'; gio ba' gu o'o tu duukam gu Jakob gu jodai' gu Jawatan gu Esauu; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gio jupaabkamu'n bhaan no'ch.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gio gook vaik gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' bhaan mii' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n bham; na pai' dhuuk jurtu'nka' dhi' tu ñi'ook gu Esauu na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug gio; gio ba' gu suudai' tu duukam gu Jakob jupaabkamu'n bhaan no'ch; na gu' jix aa'; jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n daak bɨɨx gu o'o tu' vupui bhaan tu' mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n gu vupui; gio ba' gu kutun jix duñia' gu ux.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu o'o vupui bhaan; gio ba' jix koox mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix búup mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' jix bhɨɨ gook gu u'vɨ gook ja'tkam na tu juan gu kutun gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu Jabok.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook ga'ra'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jakob gu duukam jix duñia' bɨɨx gu chio'ñ bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix ñi' cham gu tanoolh bɨɨx jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu Jakob gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx jix duu.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu takarui' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' cham tu' mi'x dhaas tu' cham gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Jakob.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jakob gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; na gu' gu jodai' bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jakob tɨtda:―¿Jax; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n jano' gu tɨɨgɨ'; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu ux gu oi'ñga'n tu ñi'ook gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' jix bhai' aa'.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Jakob gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu Peniel; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt ka't gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu tas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu Peniel; gio ba' jix duñia' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ux dhi' cham kua'da' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' jix duñia' gu Jakob dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Jakob gu vupui jix duñia' gu suudai' gu jodai' gu Esauu gu oi'ñga'n gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx; gio ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' a'aalh tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Leea gu Rakêl gook ja'tkam na tu juan.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas ja'tkam na tu juan a'aalh vupui bhaan; gio ba' gu Leea a'aalh; mi' dhɨr gu Rakêl gu Josee gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan jix duñia' gu oidha' kɨɨv mui'kim bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Esauu dai'bus gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' mi'x juu'ñ bhaan baakux gu chuukug; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu vupui jix ñi' gu u'vɨ a'aalh; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu takarui' suulhgia' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr a'aalh gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' ja'tkam na tu juan a'aalh jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Leea bɨɨx a'aalh jix duñia'; gio ba' mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Josee gu Rakêl gio jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx bɨx dhi' gu chuukug gu takarui' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook nɨidhidha' gu vupui gu Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Esauu; gio ba' jix bhai'x no'ñ tu' xibhɨk gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr ka't na ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jakob; gio ba' cham tu' soi'ñ tu' gaagam jano' nɨidhidha' gu vupui jix bhɨɨ gu o'o gu novɨ buupui gu vupui na ja'p tu' gu ñi'ook buupui gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ tu' soi'ñ gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ tu' gu chuukug; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bɨx cham tu'x jai'ch gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' bɨɨx jix bhɨɨ.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jiim gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr tu' tu jiim vupui bhaan tu'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu maa'nkar a'aalh jix bhai'x no'ñ kakneer gu jodai' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' gu jodai' gu tanoolh koi bɨx kakneer.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n jano' gu Jawatan vupui bhaan tu duukam tu' tu jiim gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ tu' vupui bhaan tu' gu oi'ñga'n a'aalh bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan gu Seir.
Ba' jix aa' gu Esauu; gio ba' mi'x dhaas jano' bɨndak gu ja'tkam jupaabkamu'n gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' nɨidhidha' gu vupui gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Esauu mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu Seir.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jakob ta'tak gu Sukkot gu vaak na ba' gu kutun na ba' gu vaakax; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu Sukkot.
Na pai' dhuuk suudai' u'va gu Jakob gu ja'tkam kiicham gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' gu Kanaan na pai' dhuuk gu jodai' gu Padan-aram; gio ba' jix duñia' vupui bhaan kiicham.
Jano' ba' jugi baasɨ'n yooxi' pai' jix duñia' vaak zel gu novɨ gu ma'nkam gu amor gu taat gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jup tɨɨt; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu Dina mar u'vɨ gu Leea ka't gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu Jakob gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu bhóogɨt gu mar gu amor gu ñi'ook gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' mii' dhɨr gu oidha' jix bhɨɨ mi'x juu'ñ bɨɨx jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu Dina mar u'vɨ gu Leea jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ gu vaak.
Ba' jix aa' gu bhóogɨt gu amor gu taat bham; gio ba' gu jodai' gu ux gu u'vɨ dhi' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu Jakob ka't gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu Dina mar u'vɨ; gio ba' kua' gu ma'nkam bɨɨx gu vaakax yooxi' gu chuukug gu Jakob bɨɨx ka'm gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu amor gu taat gu bhóogɨt gu Jakob na ba' ñiokda' bɨɨx.

Na pai' dhuuk gu ma'nkam gu Jakob tɨɨtɨs yooxi' na pai' dhuuk jix duñia'; na gu' jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' jix jai' na gu' jix duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel mi'x juu'ñ bɨɨx mar u'vɨ gu Jakob cham gu chuukug gu suudai' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu amor bɨɨx bham; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu mar gu bhóogɨt tu' gu oi'ñga'n mar u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n jix maa gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx no'ch; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt ma'nkam u'uuvɨ jix bhɨɨ gu takarui' mar u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx no'ch; na gu' gu oidha' jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr jix koi jix duñia' jix bhɨɨ gu maa'nkar.
Ba' jix aa' gu bhóogɨt gio gu taat gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' nɨidhidha' gu vupui gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug jix jai' jix duñia' juana' tu' gu suudai' gu jodai' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Jakob gu bhóogɨt gu amor gu taat bɨɨx iatda'; na gu' jix duñia' na gu' ka't gu takarui' gu Dina gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' cham gu takarui' bhaan dhi' gu chuukug gu kutun gu ja'tkam gu chio'ñ juraa'n gu ñi'ook; na gu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Gu' gu' bɨɨx dhi' gu chuukug chulhiiñchuda' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu suudai' na ja'p no'ch gu oi'ñga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨx gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n mar u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu takarui' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook duduaka' gu ja'tkam.
Gu' gu' tu' cham gu oi'ñga'n naak na ba' tu jiim jix bhɨɨ gu kutun mar u'vɨ gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu amor gu bhóogɨt gu mar gu amor.
Na gu' cham jix duñia' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr na gu' mar u'vɨ gu Jakob ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' ka't gu oi'ñga'n nɨidhat bɨx gu vaak gu taat.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu amor gu bhóogɨt gu mar tɨɨtɨs ki'ñgob kiicham tu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ kiicham bham.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx no'ch jix daa gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia'; na gu' gu suudai' gu oidha' gu jodai' gu ux na tu ibai' na ba'; mi' dhɨr no'ch jix bhɨɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ux gu u'vɨ gu oi'ñga'n mar u'vɨ.
Gu' gu' bɨɨx dhi' gu chuukug jix duu dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook jix daa bɨɨx no'ch na ba' tu'ch gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n no'ch bɨx gu chio'ñ na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu vaakax ka't gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx jix daa bɨɨx no'ch.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu amor gu bhóogɨt gu mar bɨx jix buus gu ux ki'ñgob kiicham jix duñia' bɨx gu chio'ñ gu suudai' jix buus gu ux ki'ñgob kiicham.

Na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' vaik gu tanoolh na pai' dhuuk gu jodai' jix gɨ' jix duñia' gook gu ma'nkam gu Jakob gu Simeoon gu Lebii gu ja'tkam gu Dina jix bhɨɨ maa'n gu kuchii tɨɨtɨs bhaan kiicham jix bhai'x mu'aa bɨx gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu amor gu bhóogɨt gu mar mu'aa gu bhóogɨt gu kuchii; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Dina gu vaak gu bhóogɨt moor.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jakob tɨɨtɨs koko'kam jix duñia' kiicham; na gu' gu suudai' gu takarui' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ kakneer gu jodai' gu ñi'ook ka't kiicham yooxi'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' bhɨɨk gu ñi'ook bɨx a'aalh gu u'vɨ jix duñia' bɨx ka't gu vaak.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jakob gu Simeoon gu Lebii; gio ba' gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu takarui' jix bhai'x jix koi gu chuukug gu oidha' gu Kananeo gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr da'p tu' gu jodai' gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu jodai' tu' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't gu suudai' gu kutun gu ja'tkam na ja'p ganai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jakob; gio ba' bamii' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Bet-el tu'; na pai' dhuuk gu vupui jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix ñi'ñ na pai' dhuuk gu takarui' xibhɨk gu Esauu.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jakob ja'tkam vaak bɨx bɨɨx mi'p; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham tu'x jai'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix tɨ'ɨ gu Bet-el; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu tanoolh gu chuukug tu' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Jakob bɨx gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu suudai' gu chuukug mi'p gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jakob jix duñia' bɨtaa'n gu ñi'ook ka't ju'ñdharan gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan jɨ'dɨlh ka't xikoolh cham bhiadat bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Jakob.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jakob gu tasi' gu oidha' gu Kanaan dhi' gu Bet-el bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't.
Jano' ba' jix duu jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jup tɨɨt pai' gu El-bet-el na gu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix koi gu Deebora gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Rebeeka ka't gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Bet-el bɨtaa'n gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Allon-bakut.
Ba' jix aa' jix ñi'ñ jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jakob na pai' dhuuk ka't gu bhóogɨt gu Padan-aram jix bhai' aa'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jakob; mi' dhɨr cham tɨɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jakob gu ñi'ook gu Israeel ka't gu tɨɨgɨ'; jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu chuukug; jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu takarui' tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' tu' jix maa gu Abraam gu Isaak gu suudai' tu'; gio ba' gu kai' mi' dhɨr tu' gu suudai' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios pai' bɨɨx ka't tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jakob gu ñi'ook mo'bon pai' ka't tu ñi'ook bɨɨx mo'bon gu jodai ja'aa bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' mi'x juu'ñ bhaan bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Jakob gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Bet-el.
Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu Bet-el ka't gu ñi'ook na ja'p ɨraab gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' na ba' gu chuukug gu Eprata na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu Rakêl ka't tu jiim gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' ka't na ja'p ka't tu jiim gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n; gio ba' cham jum i'obh gio gu oi'ñga'n dhi' gu mar.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu jodai' gu i'ii'ñ jix koi jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Benoni; gu' gu taat jup tɨɨt gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Rakêl ka't gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu Eprata gu Bet-leem.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Jakob mo'bon bhaan gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' dhi' mo'bon gu bhóogɨt gu Rakêl bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ta'tak gu Israeel jix duñia' vaak zel baasɨ'n gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel mii' dhɨr gu oidha' ka't gu Rubeen jix koox bɨɨx gu Bila gu u'vɨ gu taat; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr jano' xoi'kam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Leea; gio ba' gu Rubeen maa'nkam mar gu Jakob gu Simeoon gu Lebii gu Judaa gu Issakâr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rakêl; gio ba' gu Josee gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Bila ja'tkam na tu juan gu Rakêl; gio ba' gu Dan gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Silpa ja'tkam na tu juan gu Leea; gio ba' gu Gad gu Aser; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Jakob jix duñia' gu Padan-aram.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Jakob gu Isaak gu taat gu Mamre kiicham gu kutun gu ebroon pai' jix duñia' gu Abraam gu Isaak.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu tanoolh gu Isaak chamaam jix bhai'x gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Isaak gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix koi ka't gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam jix bhai'x gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Esauu gu Jakob gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu ma'nkam gu Esauu gu Edom.
Jano' ba' gu Esauu jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Kanaan; gio ba' gu Ada mar u'vɨ gu Eloon gu takarui' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Ana mar u'vɨ gu Sibeoon gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Basemat mar u'vɨ gu Ismael gu ja'tkam gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu Ada jix duñia' gu Esauu gu Elipas; gio ba' gu Basemat jix duñia' gu Reuel.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jeuus gu Jaalam gu Kora; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Esauu jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Kanaan.

Jano' ba' gu Esauu jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu suudai' bɨx gu vaakax bɨx gu i'ii'ñ ka't gu jodai' gu oidha' gu Kanaan ka't gu oidha' vupui bhaan gu Jakob xibhɨk.
Na gu' na gu' gu i'ii'ñ ka't jix gɨ' cham gu ñi'ook jix daa tɨtda:―Aañ tu' gu oidha' gu chuukug gu tanoolh gu chuukug kuiñcha gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu Esauu jix daa gu kavɨk gu Seir; gio ba' gu Esauu gu Edom.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Esauu gu taat gu Edom gu kavɨk gu Seir.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ma'nkam gu Esauu; gio ba' gu Elipas gu mar gu Ada gu u'vɨ gu Esauu; mi' dhɨr gu Reuel gu mar gu Basemat gu u'vɨ gu Esauu.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Elipas jix bɨɨx duu gu Temaan gu Omar gu Sepo gu Gatam gu Kenas.
Jano' ba' gu Timna ka't gu u'vɨ gu Elipas gu mar gu Esauu jix duñia' gu Amalek; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Ada gu u'vɨ gu Esauu.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Reuel jix bɨɨx duu gu Naat gu Sera gu Samma gu Missa; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Basemat gu u'vɨ gu Esauu.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ gu Esauu mar u'vɨ gu Ana ka't mar u'vɨ gu Sibeoon; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Esauu gu Jeuus gu Jaalam gu Kora.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt gu ma'nkam gu Esauu; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Elipas maa'nkam mar gu Esauu; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug gu Temaan gu chuukug gu Omar gu chuukug gu Sepo gu chuukug gu Kenas.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Kora gu chuukug gu Gatam gu chuukug gu Amalek; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt gu Elipas gu oidha' gu Edom; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Ada.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Reuel gu mar gu Esauu; gio ba' gu chuukug gu Naat gu chuukug gu Sera gu chuukug gu Samma gu chuukug gu Missa; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Reuel gu oidha' gu Edom; jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam jupaabkamu'n gu Basemat gu u'vɨ gu Esauu.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ gu Esauu; gio ba' gu chuukug gu Jeuus gu chuukug gu Jaalam gu chuukug gu Kora; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu bhóogɨt moor gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ gu Esauu mar u'vɨ gu Ana.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Esauu gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu Edom.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Seir gu oreo jix koi mii' dhɨr gu oidha'; gio ba' gu Lotaan gu Sobal gu Sibeoon gu Ana.
Jano' ba' gu Disoon gu Eser gu Disaan; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt gu oreos gu ma'nkam gu Seir gu oidha' gu Edom.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lotaan jix bɨɨx duu gu ori gu emaan; gio ba' gu Timna ka't gu ja'tkam gu Lotaan.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sobal jix bɨɨx duu gu Albaan gu Manaat gu Ebal gu Sepo gu Onaan.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sibeoon jix bɨɨx duu gu chuukug gu Ana; na pai' dhuuk dhi' gu Ana jix ñi'ñ gu jodai' oidha' jix gaki na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Sibeoon gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ana jix bɨɨx duu gu Disoon gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Ana.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Disoon; gio ba' gu emdaan gu Esbaan gu Itram gu Keraan.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Eser; gio ba' gu Bilaan gu Saabaan gu Akaan.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Disaan; gio ba' gu us gu Araan.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu bhóogɨt gu oreos; gio ba' gu chuukug gu Lotaan gu chuukug gu Sobal gu chuukug gu Sibeoon gu chuukug gu Ana.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Disoon gu chuukug gu Eser gu chuukug gu Disaan; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu bhóogɨt gu oreos; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha' gu Seir.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Edom va'k gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu dhi' ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Bela gu mar gu Beor jix gɨ'kora' gu Edom; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' kiicham ka't gu Dinaba.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Bela jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Jobab gu mar gu Sera gu Bosra.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Jobab pai' jix gɨ'kora' gu usam gu oidha' gu Temaan.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu usam jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Adad gu mar jix duñia' naaka'n gu Midiaan yooxi' gu Moab; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' kiicham ka't gu Abit.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Adad pai' jix gɨ'kora' gu Samla gu Masreka.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Samla jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Sauul gu Reobot gɨ' suudai' jiim.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Sauul pai' gu kutun jix gɨ'kora' gu Baalanaan gu mar gu Akbor.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Baalanaan gu mar gu Akbor jix gɨ'kora' gu Adar pai' gu kutun; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' kiicham ka't gu Pau; mi' dhɨr gu tɨɨgɨ' gu u'vɨ gu Meetabel mar u'vɨ gu Matred mar u'vɨ gu Mesaab.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu bhóogɨt gu Esauu gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux pai' gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' gu chuukug gu Timna gu chuukug gu Alba gu chuukug gu Jetet.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu Ela gu chuukug gu Pinoon.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Kenas gu chuukug gu Temaan gu chuukug gu Mibsar.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Magdiel gu chuukug gu iram; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu bhóogɨt gu Edom gu ux gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu maa'nkar; mi' dhɨr gu Edom gu Esauu gu taat gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix daa gu Jakob gu oidha' pai' jix duñia' gu taat gu oidha' gu Kanaan.

Jano' ba' dhi' jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Jakob; gio ba' gu Josee gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt mambhɨɨx kɨɨv gu takarui' jix duñia' kakneer bɨɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu vaak ka't bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Bila bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Silpa gu u'vɨ gu taat; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Josee gu taat gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n.
Na gu' dha'da' gu Israeel gu Josee gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu ma'nkam na gu' ka't jix duñia' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix uam.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu ja'tkam gu taat dha'da' gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook ñiokda' jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Josee gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jano' dhi' gu vaak gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu novɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi' gu suudai' gu novɨ jix búup ka't gu ñi'ook gu novɨ mi'p xikoolh jix duñia' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' bhaan no'ch tu' gu takarui' bhaan no'ch gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n kuiñcha tɨɨtki' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' gu suudai' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu tas gu masad gu kutun gu si'avag jix duñia' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu taat gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu taat jix duñia' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu vaak dhi' gu suudai' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook tu' gu naan gu ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam ko'kmarak jɨɨgak gu' gu taat gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ja'tkam gu chuukug kakneer gu taat gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' gu Israeel gu Josee; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu chuukug kakneer gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr gu kutun tu' gu oi'ñga'n; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jano' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook kakneer gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr bhañ gu ñi'ook gu ebroon jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu ux yooxi' tɨtda:―¿Jax mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook duukat gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr tu' a'ga; jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Dotaan; gio ba' jano' ba' gu Josee ka't bhaan gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Dotaan.
Jano' ba' na ja'p bhaan jix duñia' gu suudai' va'k mia'n gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bhaan na ba' mu'aa'.
Jano' ba' gui'p maa'n; gio ba' gu suudai' jupaabkamu'n gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jano' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' mi'x juu'ñ gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaakax jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook ka't tɨɨtki'.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu Rubeen jix kai dhi' jix duñia' gu noobh; gio ba' cham gu chuukug.

Ba' jix aa' gu Rubeen; gio ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr; mi' dhɨr mi'x juu'ñ dhi' gu ja'tkam oidha' jix gaki cham gu suudai' gu novɨ; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu noobh na ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu taat.
Na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu Josee gu ja'tkam jix duu cham kutun gu Josee gu ñi'ook jix uam ga'ra' bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' gu ja'tkam; gu' gu ja'tkam ka't gu suudai' cham ka't gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix dhadhaa jugi gu takarui'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu vupui jix duñia' gu suudai' chu'p gu Ismaelitas gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix ai gu bhóogɨt gu ux na tu ibai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Ejipto.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Judaa gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu chuukug chulhiiñdha' xibhɨk gu takarui' koi'm.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Ismaelitas cham ka't gu kutun gu novɨ bhaan; na chulhiiñdha' xibhɨk gu kutun gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam jix duñia' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu Midianitas jix duñia' gu Josee gu ja'tkam aichdhak jiix gu ñi'ook gu Ismaelitas gu ux gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai; gio ba' bhɨɨk gu Josee gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu Rubeen jix duñia' gu ja'tkam cham gu ñi'ook gu Josee gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu takarui' cham gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' gu jodai' tu jiim tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu Josee gu tasi' chiiw gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' mɨjɨ gu ñi'ook jix uam aichdhak gu taat gui'p; gio ba' dhi' gu jodai' gaagam gu takarui' jano' tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu mar.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu mar; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaakax jix duñia'; jano' ba' gu Josee tu' jix duñia' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Jakob jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ jix dhaas gu ux bhaan gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ux gu mar mui'x gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' jix búup bɨx gu ma'nkam bɨx ma'nkam u'uuvɨ na ba' gu ñi'ook; gu' cham gu oi'ñga'n jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook jix aa'; na gu' tu' no'ñ jix dhaav gu mar gu chuukug bɨɨx ka'm gu bhóogɨt; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu Midianitas gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto gu Potipar gu bhóogɨt gu Faraoon gu suudai' nukadham.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Judaa jix dhaav bɨɨx gu ja'tkam ka't gu chio'ñ gu Adullamita jup tɨɨt gu ira.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Judaa mar u'vɨ gu chio'ñ gu Kananeo jup tɨɨt gu Suua; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ chɨbiapui.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu mar; gio ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Er.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu mar jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Onaan.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu jodai' jix duñia' gu mar jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Sela; na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Kesib na pai' dhuuk jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Judaa jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ na ba' maa'nkam mar gu Er jup tɨɨt gu Tamar.
Jano' ba' gu Er maa'nkam mar gu Judaa ka't cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Judaa gu Onaan; gio ba' ba'k gu u'vɨ xibhɨk gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu chuukug gu kai' xibhɨk.
Na pai' dhuuk pu'ñir gu Onaan gu kai' cham ka't gu suudai' gu jodai' gu tanoolh na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu u'vɨ xibhɨk gu jodai' gu oidha' gu ux cham gu chuukug gu kai' xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gio jix duñia' gu oidha'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Judaa gu Tamar gu suudai'; gio ba' tu' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam gu vaak gu taat bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Sela gu mar; na gu' jix aa'; na gu kutun cham gu jodai' gio na ja'p gu ja'tkam; gio ba' ka't gu Tamar juruuñ gu vaak gu taat.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' mui'x gu tanoolh jix koi mar u'vɨ gu Suua gu u'vɨ gu Judaa; gio ba' gu Judaa gu ñi'ook jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan kakneer gu Timnat gu ja'tkam gu ira gu Adullamita.
Jano' ba' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Tamar bham; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Timnat bhaan kakneer.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' bhaan jajannulhi'ñ gu bhóogɨt jix bhaan dhaas bɨɨx jix duñia' jix dhaas ki'ñgob gu suudai' ju'ñdharan gu bhóogɨt gu Timnat; na gu' gu chuukug ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu Sela cham ka't gu jodai' gu ux gu u'vɨ.
Na gu' jix ñi' gu Judaa jix duñia' gu ux ganai' na gu' ka't jix bhaan dhaas gu vupui.
Ba' jix aa' jix ai'chdhix gu bhóogɨt bhaan; gio ba' tu' jano' ba'k tu'; na gu' cham bhai'x ka't gu suudai'; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug tu' gu oi'ñga'n tu'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaakax gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx ka'm gu oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu suudai' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ; jano' ba' jix maa chɨbiapui jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix búup ka't; gio ba' jix duñia' bhaan jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu Judaa bhañ gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu novɨ gu ja'tkam gu Adullamita na ba' jix bhɨɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu novɨ gu u'vɨ; gu' cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tɨtda:―¿Jax gu chichio'ñ mii' dhɨr pai' bham; gio ba' duukat ganai' gu suudai' ju'ñdharan gu bhóogɨt gui'p; mi' dhɨr cham tu' dhi' ganai'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Judaa; gio ba' cham gaagam; mi' dhɨr gio gu chichio'ñ pai' gui'p; jano' ba' cham tu' dhi' ganai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Judaa; na gu' gu chuukug na ba' na gu' cham tu'ch gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu bhóogɨt tu' cham bakia'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu maa'nkar vaik masaa'n ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Judaa bham; gio ba' gu Tamar gu suudai' tu' jix duñia' gu suudai' tɨɨda' gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr gu Judaa jix aa'; jano' ba' jix buusñi ka't vaak na jix bhaan.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' bhañ a'ga gu ñi'ook na jix bhai'; gio ba' gu chio'ñ dhi' tu'x dhi' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu oi'ñga'n; jano' ba' gu suudai' jano' gu oi'ñga'n dhi' tu'x gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Judaa jix duñia'; na gu' gu oi'ñga'n gu tasi' tu' na gu' cham jix maa gu Sela gu mar; mi' dhɨr cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu suudai' ka't gook vook.
Na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug jix buusñi gu novɨ maa'n baasɨ'n jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' gu novɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak bham; gio ba' dhi' jix buus maa'n.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook ka't gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu novɨ gu suudai' xibhɨk jix buus; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' gu chuukug jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix buus xibhɨk ga'ra' gu novɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Sara.
Jano' ba' baabuk gu Josee gu Ejipto jugi gu Potipar gu bhóogɨt gu Faraoon gu suudai' nukadham gu chio'ñ gu Egipkio gu novɨ gu Ismaelitas gu suudai' baabuk.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx gu Josee ka't gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' ka't gu vaak gu Jawatan gu Egipkio.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx bɨx jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu tasi' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Josee nɨidhidha' gu vupui gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' jix duu gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu vaak do'ñcho gu suudai' bɨx ga'ra'.

Ba' jix aa' ka't dɨr na pai' dhuuk jix maa gu bhóogɨt gu vaak bɨx ga'ra' gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai' aa' gu vaak gu Egipkio kuiñcha gu Josee; gio ba' jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan bɨx ga'ra' gu vaak na ja'p yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx ga'ra' gu novɨ gu Josee; gio ba' tu' bɨɨx bhai'x cham tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' jugi; mi' dhɨr ka't gu Josee gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' ka't mi' dhɨr dhi' gu u'vɨ gu Jawatan jix dhaas gu vupui gu Josee; gio ba' gu jodai' gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu u'vɨ gu Jawatan; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan cham gu maa'nkar gu chuukug cham tu'x jai'ch gu vaak tu' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ bɨx juraa'n.

Na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch jix gɨ' tu' dhi' gu vaak matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook tu' na gu' tu' gu chuukug gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug tu' dhi' jix gɨ' cham bhai' gu chuukug bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't a'gi'ñchu' gu Josee gu tanoolh cham gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu chuukug bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' ka't chɨbiapui gu tanoolh gu vaak na ba' duñia' gu ja'tkam cham ka't soo'mchulhdhak gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ux gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu jodai' gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu noobh jix duñia' jix buus mai'.
Na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' na pai' dhuuk jix ñi' ka't tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu ñi'ook gu noobh ka't jix duñia' mai'.
Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt gu vaak bham; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu jodai' gu ebreo na ba' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n no'ch; mi' dhɨr suudai' u'va tu' na ba' koox gu chuukug tu' jiiñak.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan tu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix buus mai'.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm suudai' u'va gu Jawatan gu vaak.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' tuutu'm gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' tu duukam gu ebreo jix bhɨɨ suudai' u'va tu' na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ja'p tu' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan tu' jix duñia' mai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' na ja'p jix kai gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt tu duukam; mi' dhɨr gu tai i'iich.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Jawatan gu Josee jix dhaas gu vaak kuupa' pai' mi'p ui'ka' gu gɨ'kora' juruuñ gu vaak kuupa'.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx gu Josee jix duñia' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch jix maa nɨidhidha' gu vupui gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu vaak kuupa'.
Jano' ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu vaak kuupa' do'ñcho gu novɨ gu Josee bɨx ui'ka' ka't mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨx duñia' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' cham gu chuukug gɨ'kora' ja'tkam kuupa' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu novɨ ka't; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' ka't mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'x gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto gu jodai' jix duñia' bhaan gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' bhaam gu Faraoon bhaan gook gu bhóogɨt bhaan gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu vaak kuupa' pai' gu Josee ka't kuupka'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jix maa gu chuukug gu Josee gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gook gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto mi'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n maa'n gu oi'ñga'n gu tukaa' maa'n jurtu'nka' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Josee gu ux gu xibh jix duñia' gu suudai' mi'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tɨtda:―¿Jax mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt gu Faraoon mi'p bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook cham bhai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu jodai' jix duñia' gu vaak cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix aa' gu Josee; jano' ba' cham gu takarui' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jano'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Josee; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu tasi' vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tasi' vaik gu chuukug; gio ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu suudai' bai'ñpu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu Faraoon ka't gu novɨ jix bhɨɨ tu' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu Faraoon jix duñia' tu' gu jodai' gu novɨ gu Faraoon.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josee; gio ba' dhi' gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr vaik gu chuukug vaik gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu maa'nkar vaik gu tanoolh gu Faraoon tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mo'o tu' gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk maa'n gu jodai' gu Faraoon gu novɨ na ja'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk gu takarui' tu' na ba' bɨndak na pai' dhuuk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ñi'ook tu' gu Faraoon gu jodai' dhi' gu vaak.
Na gu' na gu' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu oidha' gu ebreos; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix dhaas kuupa'.
Ba' jix aa' ñɨi'ñ gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu suudai' ka't jix duñia' na ba' xoi'kam gu Josee; gio ba' gio tu' jix duñia' gu chuukug vaik gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' bhaan mo'o.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x ka't bɨx koi' gu Faraoon gu ñi'ook gu jodai'; gio ba' gu u'uvhig gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt bhaan mo'o.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Josee; gio ba' dhi' gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr vaik gu bhóogɨt vaik gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu maa'nkar vaik gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu Faraoon mo'o bhaan tu' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu u'uvhig jugi gu chuukug bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' jix duu ka't vaik gu tanoolh gu jodai' gu Faraoon gu takarui' bɨx gu chuukug; gio ba' jix duñia' mo'o gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n mo'o gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu suudai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' jix maa gu jodai' gu novɨ gu Faraoon.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu' gu takarui' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu suudai' na ja'p ka't jix duñia' gu Josee.
Jano' ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n cham tɨ'ñcho gu Josee gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' ka't gu oi'ñga'n gook gu takarui' jix duñia' gu Faraoon gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu chuukug ka't ju'ñdharan gɨ' suudai' jiim.
Jano' ba' gɨ' suudai' jiim jix tɨ'ɨ kɨɨv gu jodai' gu ñi'ook ñiata gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu jodai' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan gɨ' suudai' jiim jix duñia' ñiata gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu ñi'ook mia'n gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jugii'ñ gɨ' suudai' jiim.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' jix duñia' ñiata gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug jix duñia' kɨɨv gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Faraoon.
Jano' ba' jix koox jix vɨɨk gu oi'ñga'n gookim jix duñia'; na kɨɨv kaipgaidhat gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix tɨ'ɨ gu duukam gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv kaipgaidhat gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu chuukug gu vaak mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv kaipgaidhat gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' kɨɨv kaipgaidhat gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhuup; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Faraoon gu suudai' ka't gu vaak.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu xibh ka't gu takarui' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ; gio ba' bhañ jix duu tɨɨt bɨx nɨi'ñdha' gu Ejipto bɨx mamatdagɨm; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Faraoon tɨɨtki' gu' cham ka't gu Faraoon gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n gu Faraoon bham; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu Faraoon bhaam bhaan tu duukam tu' mi'x juu'ñ gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu suudai' gu ñi'ook tu' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu tukaa'; gio ba' maa'n gu oi'ñga'n jurtu'nka' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' ka't bɨɨx no'ch gu takarui' gu ebreo gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' nukadham; gio ba' gu jodai' jix duñia' gu vaak tɨɨtki' jix duñia' maa'n jurtu'nka' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p jix duñia' ka't; gio ba' tu' jix duu gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Faraoon bhañ jup tɨɨt gu Josee; gio ba' jix duu gu vaak jix duñia' kuupa' jix duñia' gu takarui' jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ suudai' u'va gu Faraoon.
Ba' jix aa' gu Faraoon gu Josee; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu vaak cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook; gu' naak a'ga tu' gu ñi'ook tɨɨtki' na ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Josee gu Faraoon bham; gio ba' cham tu'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Faraoon gu Josee; gio ba' gu vaak gu chuukug ka't jugii'ñ gɨ' suudai' jiim.
Jano' ba' gɨ' suudai' jiim jix tɨ'ɨ kɨɨv gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu jodai' jix tɨ'ɨ mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham buupui tuutu'm bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux jix duñia' kɨɨv tumiiñku gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na gu' jix duñia' ba'k gu' cham gu suudai' kia'mi'ñ na gu' gu suudai' ka't gu bhóogɨt cham bhai' na ja'p maa'n; gio ba' tu' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gio gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kɨɨv kaipgaidhat jix tɨ'ɨ gu oi'ñga'n jix bhuup gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv kaipgaidhat gu oi'ñga'n gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu takarui' gu chuukug jix tɨ'ɨ mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' kaipgaidhat gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' kɨɨv kaipgaidhat gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu takarui' tu ñi'ook nɨi'ñdha' gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa' gu Josee gu Faraoon; gio ba' gu vaak gu Faraoon maa'n; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu Faraoon tu' bhaan.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kɨɨv gu takarui'; gio ba' kaipgaidhat gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kɨɨv gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr gu vaak maa'n.
Jano' ba' gio kɨɨv gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan kɨɨv gu takarui'; gio ba' kɨɨv kaipgaidhat gu oi'ñga'n gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu chuukug kɨɨv gu takarui' ka't bhiogi'.
Jano' ba' dhi' tu ñi'ook gu Faraoon; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' bhaan gu oi'ñga'n gu Faraoon.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jupaabkamu'n kɨɨv gu takarui' jix gɨ' gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix búup bhaan kɨɨv gu takarui' bhiogi'; gio ba' bɨx gu bhóogɨt ka't gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu oidha' gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr bhiogi' gu takarui' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tasi' cham mi'x juu'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kuiñcha bhiogi' buimgidhak ka't gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu vaak gu Faraoon gook mui'kim gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ duñia'.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu chuukug jano' gu Faraoon gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x gu chuukug bhaan gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n dhi' gu Faraoon jix duñia' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' bhaan gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu Ejipto kɨɨv gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug bɨx gu duukam dhi' ja'tkam jix bhai' gu takarui' jupaabkamu'n gu takarui' tiriik gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu Faraoon na ba' jugi jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu duukam gu ñi'ook na ba' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' kɨɨv gu takarui' bhiogi' ka't gu oidha' gu Ejipto; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n cham gu ñi'ook bhiogi'.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Faraoon tu duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Faraoon tu duukam; gio ba' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ na ja'p gu ux ka't gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Faraoon gu Josee; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook maachim bɨx dhi' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n tu' jix bhai'x na ja'p tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' ka' bhaan gu vaak gu ux tu ñi'ook jix duñia' bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu suudai' atooxkor jix duñia' tu' jix gɨ' tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu oi'ñga'n gu Faraoon gu Josee; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu Faraoon jix duñia' gu chuukug gu novɨ jix dhaas gu novɨ gu Josee gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu takarui' jix dhaas gu takarui' jix uam jodai baakux.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix tɨ'ɨ gook gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' vupui bhaan; gio ba' jix duñia' tooton; mi' dhɨr jix dhaas bhaan bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Ba' jix aa' gu Faraoon gu Josee; gio ba' tu' gu Faraoon; mi' dhɨr cham tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu novɨ tu' tɨɨt bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Faraoon gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Josee gu Sapnat-paanea; gio ba' jix maa gu ux gu u'vɨ gu Asenat mar u'vɨ gu Potipera jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr jix buus gu Josee gu ux bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Josee gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu takarui' na pai' dhuuk ka't gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto; gio ba' jix buus gu Josee vupui bhaan gu Faraoon jix duñia' gu ux bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu oidha' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam kɨɨv gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gɨ' kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ bɨx jugi kɨɨv gu takarui' jix bɨɨx duu gu oidha' gu Ejipto nukadham jugi jɨ'dɨlh gu takarui' kiicham jugi yooxi' xikoolh.
Na gu' jix duñia' gu Josee tiriik na ja'p oo' gu gɨ' suudai' jix jai' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm cham jix bhaai' gu ñi'ook na gu' cham ga'ra' jɨɨ'ñdhidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Josee gook gu ma'nkam va'k gu suudai' maa'n oi'ñga' bhiogi' jix duñia' gu Asenat mar u'vɨ gu Potipera jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Josee gu tɨɨgɨ' maa'nkam mar gu Manasees; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' jix duu gu ñi'ook bɨx tu jiim bɨx gu vaak gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gook jup tɨɨt gu Epraim; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' jix duu gu takarui' gu oidha' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' kɨɨv gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt ka't gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' kua'da' jix ai kɨɨv gu takarui' bhiogi' na ja'p gu Josee ka't tu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't bhiogi' bɨx gu maa'nkar gu' bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto ka't gu takarui'.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' bhiogi' bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook gu Faraoon gu ux gu takarui'; gio ba' jix aa' gu Faraoon bɨx gu Egipkios; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu Josee xoi'kam gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' bhiogi' ka't gu ux bɨx gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' jano' ba' jix kupi'ook gu Josee bɨx gu suudai' pai' ka't gu tanoolh gu Egipkios; na gu' ka't gu oi'ñga'n bhiogi' gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Na gu' bɨx gu oidha' gu jodai' gu Ejipto na ba' jugi gu Josee na gu' gu ux bɨx gu oidha' ka't gu oi'ñga'n bhiogi'.
Ba' jix aa' ñɨi'ñ gu Jakob gu Ejipto ka't gu jodai' gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook tɨɨgɨk.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' naak cham tu'x jai'ch gu suudai' gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' jugi na ba' no'ch na ba' gu oi'ñga'n duaka' cham vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' jix dhaav mambhɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu Josee jugi tiriik gu Ejipto.
Gu' gu' gu Jakob cham bhañ gu Benjamiin xibhɨk gu Josee bɨɨx gu ja'tkam; na gu' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham ka't gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu kutun gu vaak.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jugi tɨjɨɨ'ñ aajidha'; na gu' ka't bhiogi' gu oidha' gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' gu Josee ka't gu Jawatan gu oidha' gu tanoolh bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu Josee jix duñia' gu vupui gu ux pai'.

Jano' ba' gu Josee na ja'p jix ñi' gu ja'tkam jix duñia'; gu' jix duu cham gu suudai' tu ñi'ook jix bhai'x jix aa'; mi' dhɨr duukat jix duñia' tɨbiap tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu oidha' gu Kanaan jugi gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu Josee jix duñia' gu ja'tkam; gu' cham gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' tɨ'ñcho gu Josee tɨɨtki' ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' tɨbiap.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu Jawatan gu chuukug; gu' tu duukam jix duñia' tɨbiap jugi gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' bɨx no'ch gu'ch gu ma'nkam gu chio'ñ; gio ba' gu'ch gu chichio'ñ tu'r; mi' dhɨr tu duukam cham pai' dhuuk jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' tɨbiap.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu duukam gu'ch gu kutun gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu chio'ñ gu oidha' gu Kanaan; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' jix ali' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx chulhiiñdha' gu taat cham gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josee; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu Faraoon cham gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk xibhɨk jix ali' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' maa'n gu ñi'ook xibhɨk; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' ui'ka' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook tu' cham tu'x jai'ch tu'r bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' cham jix duñia' gu Faraoon gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ kuupa' gu ux vaik gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' vaik gu tanoolh gu Josee; gio ba' xoi'kam dhi' gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr tu' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu chichio'ñ tu'r jix duñia' kuupka' gu vaak kuupa' maa'n gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jugi na ba' bhiogi' gu vaak.
Gu' gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook xibhɨk jix ali' ka't gu takarui' gu ñi'ook cham koi; gio ba' gu takarui' jix duu.

Jano' ba' am:―Ja'pji maa'n; na pai' dhuuk gu vaak gu jodai' uañi'ñ bhaan chulhiiñdha' xibhɨk gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' cham gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu ñi'ook tu' tɨbiap bhaan no'ch dhi' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Rubeen jix aa' bham; gio ba' cham tu ñi'ook tu'; mi' dhɨr cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu takarui'; jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu suudai' gio gu ɨ'ɨr gu jodai'.
Na gu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh gu Josee na gu' ka't gu oi'ñga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix ai'chdhix gu ñi'ook; gio ba' mi' dhɨr jix duñia' tu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Simeoon jix duñia' ñiata.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Josee gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt tiriik gu chuukug tuumiñ maa'n gu suudai' gu ux gu ñi'ook jugi na ba' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jix duu bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas tiriik bhaan gu ñi'ook jix bɨɨx duu.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook maa'n gu ux na ba' gu chuukug jugi gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar jix ñi' tuumiñ ka't gu chin gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tuumiñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu takarui' gu ux; mi' dhɨr daam jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gui'p maa'n; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jakob gu taat gu oidha' gu Kanaan jix duñia' bɨx ka't gu oi'ñga'n bham.
Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan gu oidha' jix bhai'x jix duñia' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' no'ch tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu'ch gu chichio'ñ tu'r cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu'ch gu kutun gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam chulhiiñdha' gu taat; gio ba' maa'n cham gu ñi'ook jix ali' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx chulhiiñdha' gu taat gu oidha' gu Kanaan.
Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan gu oidha'; gio ba' dhi' gu takarui' gu chichio'ñ tu'r; mi' dhɨr mi'x dhaas gu chuukug maa'n gu ja'tkam jix bhɨɨ na ba' bhiogi' gu vaak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' xibhɨk jix ali' na ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n cham gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ tu'r; gio ba' gu suudai' xibhɨk jix duñia' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu ux maa'n ka't gu ñi'ook tuumiñ; gio ba' ñɨi'ñ gu taat gu ñi'ook tuumiñ chooto'n choo'n.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu taat gu Jakob; gio ba' gu takarui' gu ma'nkam; mi' dhɨr gu Josee cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu Simeoon gu suudai' gu Benjamiin jix duñia'; jano' ba' bhaan tu' bɨx dhi' tu'x.
Ba' jix aa' gu Rubeen gu taat bham; gio ba' jix duu koi gook gu ma'nkam tu' cham tu' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' gu novɨ tu' gu jodai' tu'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham jix dhaav gu mar bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; na xibhɨk jix koi gu duukam tu' jix duñia'; jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu kutun gu vaak gu bhóogɨt gu ux pai' gu takarui' jix duu jix dhaav gu jodai' bɨɨx gu duukam gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' bhiogi' ka't jix gɨ' gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' ka't na ja'p jix bɨɨx duu jugi tiriik aichdhak gu Ejipto gu taat; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x jugi na ba' no'ch gu vaak jugi.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Judaa bham; gio ba' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ jix duñia' bɨɨx gu takarui' gu suudai' bham; mi' dhɨr cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vupui cham xibhɨk bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñdha' xibhɨk bɨɨx no'ch gu bhóogɨt tu' jugi.
Gu' gu' tu' cham gu ñi'ook cham gu bhóogɨt; na gu' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vupui cham xibhɨk bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Israeel; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duu gu jodai' cham bhai' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ ko'kmarak gu oi'ñga'n xibhɨk.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ tɨtda:―¿Jax jix bhai'x gu ux no'ch gu ux gu kutun gu bhóogɨt bham; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu taat namki' xibhɨk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jurtu'nka' dhi' gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu tanoolh no'ch maachim ka't a'ga; gio ba' xoi'kam gu kutun xibhɨk.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Judaa gu Israeel gu taat; gio ba' gu jodai' gu takarui' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' cham vaak jodai no'ch tu' gu ñi'ook a'aalh.
Jano' ba' gu Yo gu takarui'; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr tu' cham tu' jix duñia' vupui bhaan tu' jix duñia' na ba' tu' gu chuukug bɨx gu tanoolh.
Na tu' cham gu chuukug tɨɨda' jano' gu chuukug tu' gu bhóogɨt gook mui'kim.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Israeel gu taat jix aa'; na gu' gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ tutkɨ gu oidha' gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu o'o gu vaak gu ux na tu ibai' gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu noobh gu maa'nkar tuumiñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu novɨ tuumiñ gu bhóogɨt gu chin gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' gu kutun ka't gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio xibhɨk gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' jix maa gu jodai' vupui bhaan mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu jodai' xibhɨk dhi' gu Benjamiin; gio ba' tu' gu suudai' gu takarui' gu ma'nkam ka't.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu o'o jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ gu maa'nkar tuumiñ gu Benjamiin; gio ba' jix búup jix dhaav gu Ejipto jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Josee.

Ba' jix aa' jix ñi' gu Josee gu Benjamiin bɨɨx gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu vaak; gio ba' jix duñia' gu vaak jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu suudai'; na gu' dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ jugi gu chuukug tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' jix duu gu chio'ñ na ja'p gu Josee; gio ba' jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu chichio'ñ gu vaak gu Josee.

Na pai' dhuuk mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ chooto'n choo'n na pai' dhuuk jix bɨɨx duu gu suudai' gu vaak gu Josee am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' gu ux tuumiñ ka't gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu jodai' na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan no'ch gu chuukug bhaan no'ch jix bhɨɨ gu ux tu duukam no'ch gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu vaak gu Josee tu ñi'ook ba'k gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu chuukug no'ch jix duñia' tu'r gu chuukug gɨ'kora' ja'tkam jugi gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p sɨlh gu maa'nkar gu suudai' gu chuukug gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu suudai' tuumiñ maa'n ka't gu chin gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ chulhiiñdha' tuumiñ jir bhai' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gio gu jodai' gu novɨ gu noobh tuumiñ na ba' jugi gu jodai'; gio ba' no'ch cham gu ñi'ook chɨkka ka't gu ñi'ook chulhiiñdha' tuumiñ gu novɨ gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook cham gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu taat jix maa chumñigam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; jano' ba' tuumiñ suudai' u'va tu'; gio ba' jix buusñi gu Simeoon.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu vaak gu Josee; gio ba' jix maa gu suudai' jix duñia' tɨɨt; mi' dhɨr jix maa jugi gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' jix duñia' gu o'o kapbhai' gu jodai' gu Josee tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh na gu' gu suudai' naak gu suudai' jugi gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Josee gu vaak aichdhak gu o'o ko'kmarak gu novɨ gu ñi'ook gu vaak jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' tɨtda:―¿Jax gu ñi'ook mi'p; gio ba' gu taat jix bhai'x gui'p gu takarui' xoi'kam jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' xoi'kam tu' tu duukam chulhiiñdha' gu taat; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' jix duñia'; jano' ba' jix duñia' jix duu tu jiim.

Ba' jix aa' gu bhóogɨt gu vupui jix ñi' gu Benjamiin xibhɨk gu mar gu naan; gio ba' gu ux xibhɨk jix ali' tu ñi'ook jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu' gu mar gu chuukug.
Na gu' jano' ba' gu Josee gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na gu' jix duñia' ba'k kuiñcha xibhɨk jix duñia' pai' jix xuaak; gio ba' chɨbiapui gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu vupui jix buus mai' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu suudai' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas na ba' dɨlhkob jix bhai'x na ba' dɨlhkob na ba' gu Egipkios bɨɨx jugi; na gu' gu Egipkios cham jɨ'xdha' jugi gu takarui' bɨɨx gu ebreos gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Egipkios.
Jano' ba' jix dhadhaa vupui bhaan jix gɨ' jurtu'nka' gu jodai' jix ali' jurtu'nka' gu jodai'; gio ba' mi'p mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' maa'n.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ koi' vupui bhaan na ba'; gu' gu maa'nkar gu Benjamiin ka't jixchamaam mui'kim na ja'p no'x; mi' dhɨr i'i jix duñia' bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Josee gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu vaak bham; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu suudai' gu chichio'ñ gu jodai' gu takarui' gu suudai' jix dhaas tuumiñ maa'n gu chin gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu vaak jix toja jodai gu chin gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix ali' bɨɨx tuumiñ tiriik; gio ba' jix duu na ja'p jix aa' gu Josee.
Jano' ba' namkia' gu xibh gu chichio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu gu jodai' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' dhaibu gu ñi'ook kiicham gu suudai' cham gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Josee gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ; gio ba' bamii' gu takarui' jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ; na pai' dhuuk gu jodai' gu takarui'; jano' ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt cham bhai' gu ux xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' cham gu chuukug i'i gu Jawatan gu ux gu takarui' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook cham bhai' jix duu.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p jix duñia' dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu takarui' tu'x cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' xoi'kam tu duukam.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' tuumiñ bakia' gu chin gu chuukug gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt dɨr gu oidha' gu Kanaan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dua'ñ jix duñia' gu vaak gu Jawatan jix toja jodai tu' jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr tu duukam ka't bakia' vaaso gu jodai' gu suudai' no'ch duduaka' tu duukam gu Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gio jano' ka't jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook ka't tu duukam gu takarui' ka't cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix maa gu ñi'ook gu o'o maa'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' jix kupi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' dɨr jix gɨ' kua'da' jix bɨɨx duu jix ali'; mi' dhɨr gu vaak ka't bakia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook maa'n gu ñi'ook suulh kiicham.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Judaa bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu vaak gu Josee gu suudai' ka't jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josee; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook cham gu i'ii'ñ gu chio'ñ na ja'p tu' gu maa'nkar jix duñia'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Judaa; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' gaagam tu' na cham jir bhai' tu duukam; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' no'ch gu'ch tu duukam gu Jawatan no'ch gio gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' ka't bakia' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk tu' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu suudai' ka't bakia' gu vaak ka't tu duukam; jano' ba' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu taat.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Judaa jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu chuukug jix duñia' tu ñi'ook tu duukam gu ñi'ook maatɨt gu Jawatan cham gu bhóogɨt gu duukam bhaan tu duukam tu' gu chuukug na ja'p gu Faraoon.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan tɨtda:―¿Jax tu duukam bham; gio ba' namki' gu taat xibhɨk.

Jano' ba' no'ch tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan; gio ba' tañia' gu taat jix bhai'x gu takarui' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam jix ali' gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr xibhɨk gu kutun jix koi gu ñi'ook gu duukam gu naan gu taat xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook tu duukam; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' no'ch tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan; na gu' gu takarui' cham jɨ'xdha' gu ñi'ook gu taat na gu' tu' mi'x dhaas gu taat koi.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook tu duukam; gio ba' tu' xibhɨk jix ali' cham gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook cham gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu vupui.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu jodai' gu taat tu duukam gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa' chulhiiñdha' gu taat; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x jugi gu vaak jugi.

Jano' ba' no'ch tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu takarui' tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' chulhiiñdha' xibhɨk ka't bɨɨx no'ch gu takarui'; na gu' cham gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vupui gu chio'ñ cham kua' bɨɨx no'ch chulhiiñdha' xibhɨk jix ali'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' tu duukam gu taat; gio ba' gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ gook jix duñia' gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' maa'n jix buus gu chuukug jix duñia' tɨɨda' ka't gu chuukug bɨɨx ka'm jano' cham buupui.
Jano' ba' tu' jix bhɨɨ gio gu ux vupui bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu kutun gu vaak jix duu jix dhaav gu jodai' bɨɨx gu vaak gu bhóogɨt.
Na pai' dhuuk jano' na pai' dhuuk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tu duukam gu taat gu takarui' cham ka't gu chuukug na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ gu jodai' gu i'ii'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug na pai' dhuuk cham gu chuukug gu takarui' koi; gio ba' tu duukam jix duu jix dhaav gu jodai' tu duukam chulhiiñdha' gu taat bɨɨx gu duukam gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' na ja'p tu duukam jix buus gu ux gu kutun gu takarui' bɨɨx gu taat bham; gio ba' tu' cham tu' jix duñia' jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' jix bhai'x na ba' gu taat bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' jix duñia' jano' tu duukam gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ñi'ook tu duukam gu Jawatan gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu ja'tkam.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook tu jiim tu' gu taat cham gu takarui' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu ux cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham bhai' daam gu taat.

Jano' ba' cham gu tanoolh tu' gu Josee jix duñia' vupui bhaan bɨx mi'p gu ñi'ook gu kutun tu ñi'ook; gio ba' xoi'kam jix buus gu chuukug bɨx; mi' dhɨr cham jix duñia' soo'mchulhdhak bɨɨx jix duu jix maati' gu Josee gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix maa jix xuaak gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chuukug gu Egipkios jix kai gio gu vaak gu Faraoon.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josee gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Josee; na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu taat gu ja'tkam cham jix duñia' tu ñi'ook na gu' mi'p gu jodai' vupui bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Josee gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu takarui' jano' tu'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia'; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Josee xibhɨk gu ñi'ook na ba' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jano' cham gu jodai' tu' gu takarui' gu chuukug jix duñia' jix bhai'x; na ba' gu oidha' bhañ gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu takarui'.
Na tu' gu bhóogɨt gook gu takarui' bhiogi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jixchamaam gu takarui' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu maa'nkar tu' oraa'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios bhañ vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha' na ba' jix duu gu oidha' gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix gɨ' dodhia'.
Jano' ba' cham mɨjɨ gu takarui' jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu taat gu Faraoon gu ux gu Jawatan bɨx gu vaak gu ux gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu taat ja'xñi; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu mar gu Josee; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Jawatan bɨx gu Ejipto; jano' ba' gu kutun tu' cham tu' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' gu Goseen dhi' mia'n tu' gu ma'nkam gu vaakax gu jodai' bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jixchamaam gu takarui' bhiogi' na gu' cham gu oi'ñga'n gampai' tu' gu vaak bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu vupui gu kutun gu vupui xibhɨk gu Benjamiin gu chin tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu maachim gu taat bɨx gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Ejipto bɨx jix duñia' buupui; gio ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu taat jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' mi'x juu'ñ bhaan baakux gu Benjamiin xibhɨk gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gio gu Benjamiin gu ñi'ook bhaan baakux.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook bhaan; gio ba' mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu Faraoon bham; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu Josee jix duñia' tɨbiap; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu vupui gu Faraoon tu duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Faraoon gu Josee; gio ba' tu' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr xoi'kam dhi'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu oidha' gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu taat gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu suudai' jix bhai' gu oidha' gu Ejipto jugi gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' xoi'kam dhi'; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook na ba' a'aalh gu u'vɨ; jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu taat gu bhóogɨt.
Na gu' cham jix maa cham tu' gu ñi'ook na gu' jix bhai' gu oidha' gu Ejipto ka't.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' jix maa gu Josee gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' gu vaak gu Faraoon jix duñia' gu suudai' na ba' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' maa'n bɨx jix maa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jajannulhi'ñ gu Benjamiin jix maa vaik gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jajannulhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu taat bhañ dhi'; gio ba' mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook tutkɨ gu Ejipto mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook tiriik gu takarui' jugi na ba' gu taat gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Ejipto jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Kanaan gu Jakob gu taat.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bham; gio ba' gu Josee jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto; jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia'; na gu' cham gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Josee ka't tu ñi'ook; gio ba' ñɨi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Josee gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jakob gu taat jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Israeel; gio ba' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu Josee gu mar jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt; jano' ba' tu jiim gu oi'ñga'n va'k tu' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' ta'tak gu Israeel bɨɨx bɨx ga'ra' suudai' u'va gu Beer-seba makgɨrxi makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu taat gu Isaak.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu tukaa'; gio ba' gu Jakob; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu taat; na gu' cham jum i'obh jix dhaav gu Ejipto na gu' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n bɨndak gu Ejipto tu' gio tu' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu Josee gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Jakob gu Beer-seba; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu taat gu Jakob a'aalh gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook gu Faraoon ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ ka't gu jodai' gu oidha' gu Kanaan tɨɨtɨs gu Ejipto gu Jakob bɨx gu kai' baidhak.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam baidhak; gio ba' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ma'nkam bɨx gu kai' jix bhɨɨ baidhak gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel baap gu Ejipto gu Jakob gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu Rubeen maa'nkam mar gu Jakob.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen; gio ba' gu anok gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu esroon gu Karmi.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon; gio ba' gu Jemuel gu Jamiin gu Oad gu Jakîn gu Soar gu Sauul gu mar gu Kananea.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii; gio ba' gu Gersoon gu Koat gu Merari.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa; gio ba' gu Er gu Onaan gu Sela gu suudai' gu Sara; gu' gu Er gu Onaan jix koko' gu oidha' gu Kanaan; jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu suudai' jix bɨɨx duu gu esroon gu amul.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Issakâr; gio ba' gu Tola gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Job gu Simroon.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Sered gu Eloon gu Jaleel.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Leea jix duñia' gu Jakob gu Padan-aram gu suudai' mar u'vɨ gu Dina; gio ba' gu ñi'ook vaik gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gad; gio ba' gu Sipioon gu Aggi gu Esboon gu Suni gu eri gu Arodi gu Areli.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aser; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Isua gu Isui gu Beria gu Sera gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Beria; jano' ba' gu eber gu Malkîel.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Silpa gu Labaan jix maa mar u'vɨ gu Leea jix duñia' dhi' ja'tkam gu Jakob; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt mambhɨɨx gu ux gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rakêl gu u'vɨ gu Jakob; gio ba' gu Josee gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Josee gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu Manasees gu Epraim jix duñia' gu Asenat mar u'vɨ gu Potipera jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' na ja'p gu suudai' cham gu ñi'ook gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; na gu' jix tɨ'ɨ dhim gu taat; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' tu' gu suudai' jix tɨ'ɨ dhaibu'.

Jano' ba' gu Judaa tu' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu novɨ gu suudai' obhɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu taat jix duñia' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug maavɨt gu Judaa; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix tɨ'ɨ gu mar gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' mi'x juu'ñ na ja'p maavɨt na ja'p maavɨt jix bhai'x; jano' ba' chɨkka jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' cham ka't gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ gu Judaa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu oi'ñga'n gu Silo; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu tasi' bhuru'x gu ñi'ook gu mar gu ñi'ook jix duñia' suudai' u'va tɨi'chu' gu ɨ'ɨr gu suudai' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu vupui gu takarui' suudai' u'va taatam jix toja bii'm.

Jano' ba' gu Dan gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam na ja'p bopxi'ñ gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' tulhiiñdha' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' u'u gat.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu taat tu' u'ua'tɨdham gu jodai' tu' jix bhai' aa' bɨɨx jix bhai' aa' gu tɨkɨr jiix bɨɨx jix bhai' aa' jix dhaam suudai' gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx jix bhai' aa' baaso gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu taat jix bɨɨx duu gu duukam gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook ka't bhaan mo'o gu Josee bhaan gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Benjamiin gu ux gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu xibh jugi gu ja'tkam gu xumai gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu kutun bopxi'ñ gu Israeel; gio ba' dhi' ka't gu taat jix aa' jix bhai' aa'; mi' dhɨr maa'n gu ux jix bhai' aa'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug bɨɨx tattat jumpa'n yooxi' gu Eproon gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jumpa'n yooxi' gu Makpela vupui bhaan gu Mamre gu oidha' gu Kanaan jugi gu Abraam bɨɨx yooxi' gu Eproon gu takarui' na ba' gu maa'nkar gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' mi'x juu'ñ gu Josee bhaan gu vupui gu taat gu ñi'ook bhaan gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Josee gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu taat; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu Israeel.
Na gu' jix duñia' oo'm gu tanoolh na gu' gu oi'ñga'n gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Egipkios gu vaak gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' gu oi'ñga'n gu tanoolh gu chuukug gu Josee gu vaak gu Faraoon bham; gio ba' tu' gaagam jano' nɨidhidha' gu vupui soi'ñ tu ñi'ook maatɨt gu Faraoon bham.

Jano' ba' gu taat jix duñia' bham; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tukga'n tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' tu' gu oidha' gu Kanaan gu chuukug; jano' ba' soi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n tu' jano' gu chuukug gu taat gu jodai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Faraoon; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu taat na ja'p tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Josee jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook gu taat; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx bɨx tu duukam gu Faraoon daraa gu vaak bɨx daraa gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu vaak gu Josee gu ja'tkam gu vaak gu taat; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Goseen a'aalh kakneer gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix tɨ'ɨ gio bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam kavaayo gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu Atad baasɨ'n gu Jordaan jix duñia' bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu bhóogɨt gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Josee jix duu gu taat gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux kɨɨv gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ jix koi gu oidha' gu Kananeos gu ñi'ook ka't gu Atad gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' dhi' gu Egipkios; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu ñi'ook ka't tɨɨgim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Abelmisraim baasɨ'n gu Jordaan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam bɨɨx bhaan ka't jix aa'ñdhix.
Na gu' bhɨɨk gu ma'nkam gu oidha' gu Kanaan gu ñi'ook jumpa'n yooxi' gu Makpela ka't jugi gu Abraam bɨɨx yooxi' na ba' gu maa'nkar gu bhóogɨt gu Eproon gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu Mamre.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Josee gu Ejipto gu ja'tkam bɨx jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu taat mi' dhɨr ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Josee gu taat ka't jix koi gui'p; gio ba' gu kutun jix duñia' gu Josee maa'n gu kutun bɨx cham bhai' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' mɨjɨ a'ga gu Josee; gio ba' gu taat jix aa'ñdhix va'k koi'm bham.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Josee; na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jano' tu' na cham jir bhai' gu ja'tkam uañi'ñ na gu' cham bhai' tu' jix duñia'; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' jano' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu taat; jano' ba' gu Josee gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gio gu ja'tkam jix duñia' vupui bhaan gui'p; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ux tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Josee; gio ba' cham gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr dhi' tu' pai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' jix duñia' cham bhai' bhaan tu' gu' gu takarui' jix duñia' xoi'kam na ba' duñia' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu suudai' gu oidha' jix jai' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jano' cham gu ja'tkam ɨɨbhi'ñ; gio ba' tu' gu takarui' gu ma'nkam; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' juruuñ gu Josee gu Ejipto gu vaak gu taat; gio ba' jix oidha' gu Josee chamaam mambhɨɨx gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Josee gu ma'nkam gu Epraim bɨɨx ka'm gu i'ii'ñ gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gio gu ma'nkam gu Makîr gu mar gu Manasees jix bɨɨx duu gu bhóogɨt bhaan kɨkbok gu Josee.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josee gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook; gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix tɨ'ɨ gu chuukug gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Josee gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix duu gu suudai' o'oo.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Josee gu bhóogɨt chamaam mambhɨɨx gu takarui'; gio ba' jix duñia' ka't gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu Ejipto.
